examples.en: The patient was kept in isolation for a week.
examples.zh: 病人被隔離了一個星期。

examples.en: Many elderly people suffer from isolation in big cities.
examples.zh: 許多長者在大城市裡飽受孤獨之苦。

examples.en: The village's isolation made it hard to get supplies.
examples.zh: 這個村莊與外界隔絕，很難取得物資。

examples.en: Pollution is an important issue for our city.
examples.zh: 污染是我們城市的重要議題。

examples.en: The magazine's April issue comes out next week.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌的四月號下週出刊。

examples.en: If you have an issue with your order, please call us.
examples.zh: 如果您的訂單有問題，請來電告知。

examples.en: The school will issue new ID cards next month.
examples.zh: 學校下個月會發行新的學生證。

examples.en: The city issued a warning about the typhoon.
examples.zh: 市政府發布了颱風警報。

examples.en: The bank issues a monthly statement to each customer.
examples.zh: 銀行每個月會提供每位客戶一份對帳單。

examples.en: Her jealousy grew when she saw her friend's new bike.
examples.zh: 她看到朋友的新腳踏車時，嫉妒心越來越強。

examples.en: Jealousy can hurt even the closest friendships.
examples.zh: 嫉妒可能傷害最要好的友誼。

examples.en: He felt a pang of jealousy when his brother won the prize.
examples.zh: 哥哥得獎時，他心裡泛起一陣嫉妒。

examples.en: She is keen on learning how to play the piano.
examples.zh: 她很熱衷於學習彈鋼琴。

examples.en: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
examples.zh: 狗的嗅覺很敏銳。

examples.en: There is keen competition for the job.
examples.zh: 這份工作的競爭非常激烈。

examples.en: Please put the kettle on and make some tea.
examples.zh: 請把水壺放上去燒水，泡點茶吧。

examples.en: The kettle whistled when the water began to boil.
examples.zh: 水一燒開，水壺就嗶嗶作響。

examples.en: We bought an electric kettle for the new office.
examples.zh: 我們為新辦公室買了一個電熱水壺。

examples.en: The child had to kneel to reach the low shelf.
examples.zh: 小孩得跪下才拿得到那個矮架子。

examples.en: Please kneel down and tie your shoelaces.
examples.zh: 請跪下來把鞋帶綁好。

examples.en: He knelt beside the bed to look for his socks.
examples.zh: 他跪在床邊找他的襪子。

examples.en: The door knob came off in my hand.
examples.zh: 門把竟然在我手裡掉了下來。

examples.en: Turn the knob to the right to raise the volume.
examples.zh: 把旋鈕往右轉就能調大音量。

examples.en: There is a small knob on the top of the lid.
examples.zh: 蓋子頂端有一個小圓鈕。

examples.en: Building the bridge took years of hard labor.
examples.zh: 建造這座橋花了好幾年的辛苦勞動。

examples.en: The company is looking for cheap labor overseas.
examples.zh: 這家公司正在海外尋找廉價勞工。

examples.en: Labor costs have gone up this year.
examples.zh: 今年的人事成本上升了。

senses.zh: 辛勞地工作；努力；吃力地行進

examples.en: Farmers labor in the fields from morning to night.
examples.zh: 農夫們從早到晚在田裡辛勤工作。

examples.en: She labored over her essay all weekend.
examples.zh: 她整個週末都在苦心撰寫她的報告。

examples.en: The old man labored up the steep hill.
examples.zh: 老先生吃力地爬上陡坡。

examples.en: The students wear white coats in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 學生們在實驗室裡穿白袍。

examples.en: She works in a laboratory at the university.
examples.zh: 她在大學的實驗室工作。

examples.en: Please do not eat or drink in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 請勿在實驗室內飲食。

examples.en: Our team started to lag behind in the second half.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍在下半場開始落後。

examples.en: Sales lagged because of the bad weather.
examples.zh: 由於天氣不好，銷售表現低迷。

examples.en: Don't lag behind the group or you will get lost.
examples.zh: 別落在隊伍後面，否則你會迷路。

examples.en: There is a short lag between the sound and the picture.
examples.zh: 聲音和畫面之間有短暫的延遲。

examples.en: Jet lag made me sleepy all day after the flight.
examples.zh: 搭機後的時差讓我一整天都昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: A lag in payment caused problems for the shop.
examples.zh: 付款延遲替這家店帶來了麻煩。

examples.en: Taipei 101 is a famous landmark in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是台灣著名的地標。

examples.en: We used the old church as a landmark to find the hotel.
examples.zh: 我們以那座老教堂為地標來找旅館。

examples.en: The new law was a landmark in the history of education.
examples.zh: 這項新法是教育史上的里程碑。

examples.en: Green hills dominate the landscape around this quiet village.
examples.zh: 這個寧靜村莊周圍的景觀以青翠的山丘為主。

examples.en: She likes to paint landscapes in her free time.
examples.zh: 她空閒時喜歡畫風景畫。

examples.en: The city has changed the landscape of the old harbor.
examples.zh: 這座城市改變了舊港口的景觀。

examples.en: The test was largely about grammar rather than vocabulary.
examples.zh: 這次考試主要考文法，而非字彙。

examples.en: The park is largely empty on weekdays.
examples.zh: 這座公園平日大多是空的。

examples.en: His success was largely due to hard work.
examples.zh: 他的成功主要歸功於努力。

examples.en: The company will launch a new phone next month.
examples.zh: 這家公司下個月將推出一支新手機。

examples.en: Scientists plan to launch the satellite in May.
examples.zh: 科學家計畫在五月發射這顆衛星。

examples.en: The students launched a project to clean the beach.
examples.zh: 學生們發起了一項淨灘專案。

examples.en: The launch of the rocket was delayed by rain.
examples.zh: 火箭的發射因為下雨而延後了。

examples.en: We attended the launch of her new book.
examples.zh: 我們參加了她新書的發表會。

examples.en: The launch of the website attracted many visitors.
examples.zh: 網站上線吸引了許多訪客。

examples.en: It is lawful to park here after six in the evening.
examples.zh: 晚上六點過後在這裡停車是合法的。

examples.en: The man is a lawful owner of the house.
examples.zh: 這位男士是這棟房子的合法所有人。

examples.en: Only lawful activities are permitted in the community center.
examples.zh: 社區活動中心只允許合法的活動。

examples.en: Please do not lean against the glass door.
examples.zh: 請不要靠在玻璃門上。

examples.en: She leaned forward to hear the teacher better.
examples.zh: 她身體前傾，想聽清楚老師說的話。

examples.en: Many young people lean toward healthier food.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人傾向選擇更健康的食物。

senses.zh: 精瘦的；少脂肪的；不景氣的

examples.en: He has a lean body from running every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上跑步，所以身材精瘦。

examples.en: I prefer lean meat to fatty meat.
examples.zh: 比起肥肉，我比較喜歡瘦肉。

examples.en: It was a lean year for the farmers.
examples.zh: 那對農夫來說是個歉收的年頭。

examples.en: The learned professor answered every question patiently.
examples.zh: 那位博學的教授耐心地回答每個問題。

examples.en: She is a learned woman who reads in four languages.
examples.zh: 她是一位博學的女性，能閱讀四種語言。

examples.en: The book was written by a learned scholar.
examples.zh: 這本書是由一位學識淵博的學者所寫。

examples.en: The lecture on climate change lasted an hour.
examples.zh: 那場關於氣候變遷的演講持續了一個小時。

examples.en: I took notes during the history lecture.
examples.zh: 我在歷史課上做了筆記。

examples.en: My father gave me a lecture about coming home late.
examples.zh: 爸爸因為我太晚回家而訓了我一頓。

examples.en: Professor Lin will lecture on art history tomorrow.
examples.zh: 林教授明天會講授藝術史。

examples.en: She lectures at the university twice a week.
examples.zh: 她每週在大學授課兩次。

examples.en: The teacher lectured us about being on time.
examples.zh: 老師訓誡我們要準時。

examples.en: The lecturer showed us some photos from her trip.
examples.zh: 講師給我們看了她旅行的一些照片。

examples.en: He works as a lecturer at a local college.
examples.zh: 他在當地一所大學擔任講師。

examples.en: The guest lecturer talked about healthy eating.
examples.zh: 客座講師談到了健康飲食。

examples.en: The legend says a dragon lives in this lake.
examples.zh: 傳說有一條龍住在這個湖裡。

examples.en: He became a legend in the world of basketball.
examples.zh: 他成了籃球界的傳奇人物。

examples.en: Children love to hear the old legends of the island.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡聽島上古老的傳說。

examples.en: We took a leisurely walk along the river.
examples.zh: 我們沿著河邊悠閒地散步。

examples.en: They enjoyed a leisurely breakfast on Sunday.
examples.zh: 他們在週日享用了悠閒的早餐。

examples.en: The train moves at a leisurely pace.
examples.zh: 這班火車以從容不迫的速度行駛。

examples.en: She strolled leisurely through the park after finishing her work.
examples.zh: 她完成工作後，悠閒地漫步穿過公園。

examples.en: The old man ate leisurely and read the newspaper.
examples.zh: 老先生一邊悠閒地吃東西，一邊看報紙。

examples.en: We leisurely packed our bags before the trip.
examples.zh: 出發前，我們不慌不忙地收拾行李。

examples.en: The tailor will lengthen the pants by two centimeters.
examples.zh: 裁縫師會把這條褲子加長兩公分。

examples.en: The school decided to lengthen the lunch break.
examples.zh: 學校決定延長午休時間。

examples.en: Days begin to lengthen in the spring.
examples.zh: 春天來臨，白天開始變長。

examples.en: Nobody trusts him because he is a liar.
examples.zh: 沒有人相信他，因為他愛說謊。

examples.en: You are a liar if you say you never make mistakes.
examples.zh: 如果你說你從不犯錯，那你就是在說謊。

examples.en: The boy who cried wolf was called a liar.
examples.zh: 喊「狼來了」的男孩被人說是騙子。

examples.en: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
examples.zh: 圖書館員幫我找到一本關於鳥類的書。

examples.en: Please ask the librarian if you want to borrow a magazine.
examples.zh: 如果想借雜誌，請詢問圖書館員。

examples.en: My aunt works as a librarian at the city library.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在市立圖書館擔任圖書館員。

examples.en: You need a license to drive a car.
examples.zh: 你需要有駕照才能開車。

examples.en: The shop has a license to sell medicine.
examples.zh: 這家店有販售藥品的執照。

examples.en: He showed his driver's license to the police officer.
examples.zh: 他向警察出示了他的駕照。

examples.en: The government licenses taxi drivers after they pass the required tests.
examples.zh: 政府在計程車司機通過規定的測驗後，核發執照給他們。

examples.en: The company is licensed to sell insurance.
examples.zh: 這家公司獲准銷售保險。

examples.en: The city will license new restaurants next year.
examples.zh: 市政府明年將發照給新餐廳。

examples.en: There is a limitation on the number of guests.
examples.zh: 賓客人數有所限制。

examples.en: Every plan has some limitations that we need to consider.
examples.zh: 每個計畫都有一些我們需要考量的侷限。

examples.en: Age is no limitation when you want to learn.
examples.zh: 想學習的話，年齡不是限制。

senses.zh: 亞麻布；床單被套等家用織品

examples.en: This shirt is made of soft linen.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫是用柔軟的亞麻布做的。

examples.en: The hotel changes the bed linen every day.
examples.zh: 飯店每天更換床單被套。

examples.en: She bought a linen tablecloth at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市場買了一條亞麻桌巾。

examples.en: She put on some red lipstick before the party.
examples.zh: 她在派對前塗了一點紅色口紅。

examples.en: This lipstick lasts all day without fading.
examples.zh: 這支口紅持久一整天都不會掉色。

examples.en: My sister bought a new lipstick at the mall.
examples.zh: 我姐姐在購物中心買了一支新口紅。

examples.en: The store is not allowed to sell liquor to teenagers.
examples.zh: 這家店不可以賣酒給青少年。

examples.en: He does not drink liquor because he has to drive.
examples.zh: 他因為要開車，所以不喝烈酒。

examples.en: A bottle of liquor was on the shelf behind the bar.
examples.zh: 吧檯後面的架上有一瓶烈酒。

examples.en: She won a literary prize for her first novel.
examples.zh: 她憑第一部小說獲得了文學獎。

examples.en: The club holds a literary evening every month.
examples.zh: 這個社團每個月舉辦一次文學之夜。

examples.en: He has a deep interest in literary history.
examples.zh: 他對文學史有濃厚的興趣。

examples.en: We read English literature in class this semester.
examples.zh: 我們這學期在課堂上讀英國文學。

examples.en: She is studying Chinese literature at university.
examples.zh: 她在大學主修中國文學。

examples.en: Please read the literature before you start the test.
examples.zh: 開始測驗前，請先閱讀相關資料。

examples.en: He took out a loan to buy a house.
examples.zh: 他貸款買了一間房子。

examples.en: The bank approved her loan yesterday.
examples.zh: 銀行昨天核准了她的貸款。

examples.en: The painting is on loan from a museum in Paris.
examples.zh: 這幅畫是向巴黎的一間博物館借來的。

examples.en: Could you loan me your pen for a moment?
examples.zh: 你可以把筆借我一下嗎？

examples.en: The bank agreed to loan them enough money.
examples.zh: 銀行同意借給他們足夠的錢。

examples.en: The museum loans paintings to schools every year.
examples.zh: 博物館每年都把畫作借給學校。

examples.en: We had lobster for dinner at the seaside restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊的餐廳晚餐吃了龍蝦。

examples.en: A lobster uses its two large claws to catch food.
examples.zh: 龍蝦用牠的兩隻大螯捕捉食物。

examples.en: The fisherman caught a large lobster this morning.
examples.zh: 漁夫今天早上捕到一隻大龍蝦。

examples.en: Her argument follows clear logic and is supported by evidence.
examples.zh: 她的論點邏輯清楚，且有證據支持。

examples.en: There is no logic in what he says.
examples.zh: 他說的話毫無道理。

examples.en: We learn basic logic in our math class.
examples.zh: 我們在數學課學習基本邏輯。

examples.en: It is logical to save money for the future.
examples.zh: 為未來存錢是合理的。

examples.en: She gave a logical answer to the question.
examples.zh: 她對這個問題給了合乎邏輯的答案。

examples.en: Math helps students develop a logical mind.
examples.zh: 數學能幫助學生培養邏輯思考的頭腦。

examples.en: Please loosen your tie if you feel hot.
examples.zh: 如果覺得熱，請把領帶鬆開。

examples.en: He loosened the screw with a small tool.
examples.zh: 他用一個小工具把螺絲鬆開。

examples.en: The doctor suggested stretches to loosen my tight shoulder muscles.
examples.zh: 醫生建議做伸展運動，放鬆我緊繃的肩部肌肉。

examples.en: The weather was lousy during our whole trip.
examples.zh: 我們整趟旅行的天氣都很糟。

examples.en: I had a lousy night because of the noise.
examples.zh: 因為吵鬧聲，我昨晚睡得很糟。

examples.en: He felt lousy after skipping breakfast before his morning class.
examples.zh: 他早上上課前沒吃早餐，覺得很不舒服。

examples.en: A dog is loyal to its owner.
examples.zh: 狗對主人很忠誠。

examples.en: She is a loyal friend who always helps me.
examples.zh: 她是一位總是幫助我的忠實朋友。

examples.en: The shop gives gifts to loyal customers.
examples.zh: 這家店會送禮給忠實顧客。

examples.en: The team admired his loyalty to the company.
examples.zh: 團隊很欣賞他對公司的忠誠。

examples.en: Loyalty is important in any friendship, especially during difficult times.
examples.zh: 忠誠在任何友誼中都很重要，尤其是在困難時期。

examples.en: The store offers a card to reward customer loyalty.
examples.zh: 這家店推出一張卡片來回饋顧客的忠誠。

examples.en: They stayed in a luxurious hotel by the sea.
examples.zh: 他們住在海邊一間豪華的飯店。

examples.en: She wore a luxurious coat made of soft wool.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件用柔軟羊毛製成的奢華大衣。

examples.en: The luxurious cabin had a large bed and a sofa.
examples.zh: 那間豪華客艙有一張大床和一張沙發。

examples.en: Time to read a book is a luxury for me.
examples.zh: 能有時間看書對我來說是一種奢侈。

examples.en: They live a life of luxury in a big house.
examples.zh: 他們在大房子裡過著奢華的生活。

examples.en: The mall sells many luxury goods, including watches and handbags.
examples.zh: 這間購物中心販售許多奢侈品，包括手錶與手提包。

examples.en: The factory bought new machinery last year.
examples.zh: 這間工廠去年購買了新機器。

examples.en: Workers must wear helmets near the heavy machinery.
examples.zh: 工人在大型機械附近必須戴安全帽。

examples.en: The machinery stopped working because of a power cut.
examples.zh: 因為停電，機器停止運轉了。

examples.en: A compass needle points toward magnetic north rather than true north.
examples.zh: 指南針的指針指向磁北，而非真北。

examples.en: A magnetic board is useful in the classroom.
examples.zh: 磁性板在教室裡很好用。

examples.en: The magnetic lock keeps the door closed.
examples.zh: 磁力鎖讓門保持關閉。

examples.en: We saw a magnificent view from the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 我們在山頂看到了壯麗的景色。

examples.en: The king lived in a magnificent castle.
examples.zh: 國王住在一座宏偉的城堡裡。

examples.en: The team gave a magnificent performance last night.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍昨晚有極為精彩的表現。

examples.en: She put on some makeup before the interview.
examples.zh: 她在面試前化了一點妝。

examples.en: I need to buy a new makeup bag.
examples.zh: 我需要買一個新的化妝包。

examples.en: The makeup of the team has changed this year.
examples.zh: 今年這支隊伍的組成有了變動。

examples.en: This car has a manual gearbox, so drivers change gears themselves.
examples.zh: 這輛車配備手排變速箱，因此駕駛必須自行換檔。

examples.en: Manual work can be tiring for older people.
examples.zh: 體力勞動對年長者來說可能很累人。

examples.en: Please switch the machine to manual mode.
examples.zh: 請把機器切換為手動模式。

examples.en: Please read the manual before using the machine.
examples.zh: 使用機器前請先閱讀說明書。

examples.en: The user manual comes with a repair guide.
examples.zh: 使用手冊附有維修指南。

examples.en: I lost the manual for my new camera.
examples.zh: 我把新相機的說明書弄丟了。

examples.en: The factory manufactures bicycles for export to several European countries.
examples.zh: 這間工廠生產腳踏車，外銷至數個歐洲國家。

examples.en: Many medical devices are manufactured under strict quality control standards.
examples.zh: 許多醫療器材是在嚴格的品質管制標準下製造的。

examples.en: They manufacture toys from recycled plastic to reduce material waste.
examples.zh: 他們用回收塑膠製造玩具，以減少材料浪費。

examples.en: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
examples.zh: 汽車的製造需要許多工人。

examples.en: Paper manufacture uses a lot of water.
examples.zh: 造紙需要用到大量的水。

examples.en: This machine is used in the manufacture of shoes.
examples.zh: 這台機器用於製鞋。

examples.en: The manufacturer offers a two-year warranty on all kitchen appliances.
examples.zh: 這家製造商為所有廚房家電提供兩年保固。

examples.en: Contact the manufacturer if the product is broken.
examples.zh: 如果產品壞了，請聯絡製造商。

examples.en: He works for a large car manufacturer.
examples.zh: 他在一家大型汽車製造商工作。

senses.zh: 馬拉松；漫長而費力的活動

examples.en: He ran his first marathon last spring.
examples.zh: 他去年春天跑了人生第一場馬拉松。

examples.en: Thousands of people joined the city marathon.
examples.zh: 數千人參加了市區馬拉松。

examples.en: The meeting turned into a marathon that lasted five hours.
examples.zh: 那場會議變成了長達五小時的馬拉松。

examples.en: Please write your notes in the margin of the page.
examples.zh: 請把筆記寫在頁面的空白處。

examples.en: She won the race by a small margin.
examples.zh: 她以些微的差距贏得比賽。

examples.en: The shop has a low profit margin on this product.
examples.zh: 這家店這項產品的利潤率很低。

examples.en: Her maturity impressed everyone at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她的成熟穩重讓會議上的每個人都印象深刻。

examples.en: Most fruit trees reach maturity after about five years.
examples.zh: 大多數果樹約五年後就會進入成熟期。

examples.en: The bond reaches maturity in March next year.
examples.zh: 這張債券將在明年三月到期。

senses.zh: 可測量的；明顯的；可衡量的

examples.en: The new diet produced measurable results within a month.
examples.zh: 新的飲食法在一個月內就產生了明顯的成效。

examples.en: Teachers should set clear and measurable goals for students.
examples.zh: 老師應該為學生訂定明確且可衡量的目標。

examples.en: There is a measurable difference in temperature between the two rooms.
examples.zh: 這兩個房間的溫度有可測量的差異。

senses.zh: 機械的；機械式的；呆板的

examples.en: The clock stopped because of a mechanical problem.
examples.zh: 時鐘因為機械故障而停了。

examples.en: He works as a mechanical engineer at a car factory.
examples.zh: 他在汽車工廠擔任機械工程師。

examples.en: Her answers sounded mechanical, as if she had memorized them.
examples.zh: 她的回答聽起來很呆板，好像是背下來的。

examples.en: Our trip to Hualien was a memorable experience.
examples.zh: 我們的花蓮之旅是一次難忘的經驗。

examples.en: The teacher gave a memorable speech at the graduation.
examples.zh: 老師在畢業典禮上發表了令人難忘的演說。

examples.en: Choose a password that is both safe and memorable.
examples.zh: 請選擇一個既安全又好記的密碼。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the memorial in the center of the city.
examples.zh: 許多遊客會參觀市中心的紀念碑。

examples.en: The class planted a tree as a memorial to their old teacher.
examples.zh: 全班種了一棵樹來紀念他們的老師。

examples.en: A small memorial stands near the entrance of the park.
examples.zh: 公園入口附近立著一座小小的紀念碑。

examples.en: The school held a memorial service for the former principal.
examples.zh: 學校為前校長舉行了追思會。

examples.en: They built a memorial library in his honor.
examples.zh: 他們興建了一座紀念圖書館來向他致敬。

examples.en: A memorial concert will be held on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 週五晚上將舉行一場紀念音樂會。

examples.en: I need to memorize fifty new words before the test.
examples.zh: 我考試前要背五十個新單字。

examples.en: The actor memorized all his lines in two days.
examples.zh: 這位演員兩天就把所有台詞背了起來。

examples.en: Can you memorize the phone number while I find a pen?
examples.zh: 我去找筆的時候，你可以先記住這個電話號碼嗎？

examples.en: The merchant sold silk and tea at the market.
examples.zh: 這位商人在市場上賣絲綢和茶葉。

examples.en: Many merchants in the old street sell handmade gifts.
examples.zh: 老街上有許多商家販售手工禮品。

examples.en: A wine merchant delivered ten boxes to the restaurant.
examples.zh: 一位酒商送了十箱酒到餐廳。

examples.en: The judge showed mercy because it was his first mistake.
examples.zh: 法官因為這是他的初犯而從輕發落。

examples.en: Please have mercy on me and give me one more day.
examples.zh: 請對我寬容一點，再多給我一天。

examples.en: The lost hikers were at the mercy of the weather.
examples.zh: 迷路的登山客只能任憑天氣擺布。

examples.en: It took a mere ten minutes to finish the homework.
examples.zh: 寫完這份功課只花了短短十分鐘。

examples.en: The mere thought of the exam makes me nervous.
examples.zh: 光是想到考試就讓我緊張。

examples.en: She is a mere child, so please be patient with her.
examples.zh: 她只是個孩子，所以請對她有耐心一點。

examples.en: Each plan has its own merits and weaknesses.
examples.zh: 每個計畫都有各自的優缺點。

examples.en: She won the scholarship on merit, not by luck.
examples.zh: 她是靠實力而不是運氣拿到獎學金的。

examples.en: The committee will judge the proposal on its merits.
examples.zh: 委員會將根據提案本身的價值來評斷。

examples.en: This idea merits further discussion at the next meeting.
examples.zh: 這個想法值得在下次會議中進一步討論。

examples.en: Her hard work merits a reward from the school.
examples.zh: 她的努力值得學校給予獎勵。

examples.en: The problem merits our careful attention before we make a decision.
examples.zh: 這個問題值得我們在做決定前仔細關注。

examples.en: The messenger brought a letter to the front desk.
examples.zh: 信差把一封信送到了櫃檯。

examples.en: He works as a bicycle messenger in the city center.
examples.zh: 他在市中心擔任單車快遞員。

examples.en: She sent me a note through a messenger at school.
examples.zh: 她在學校請人幫忙傳了張紙條給我。

examples.en: My little brother's room is always messy.
examples.zh: 我弟弟的房間總是亂糟糟的。

examples.en: Eating spaghetti can be messy for young children.
examples.zh: 小朋友吃義大利麵可能會弄得一團亂。

examples.en: The business partners faced a messy dispute over their contract.
examples.zh: 這些生意合夥人因合約問題陷入棘手的爭執。

examples.en: We looked at onion cells under a microscope in biology class.
examples.zh: 我們在生物課用顯微鏡觀察洋蔥細胞。

examples.en: The lab bought a new microscope for the students.
examples.zh: 實驗室為學生買了一台新的顯微鏡。

examples.en: You can see tiny bacteria only with a powerful microscope.
examples.zh: 你只有用高倍顯微鏡才看得到微小的細菌。

examples.en: Taiwan has a mild climate in the spring.
examples.zh: 台灣的春天氣候溫和。

examples.en: He had a mild cold and stayed home for a day.
examples.zh: 他得了輕微的感冒，在家休息了一天。

examples.en: I prefer mild cheese to strong cheese.
examples.zh: 比起味道濃烈的起司，我比較喜歡口味溫和的。

examples.en: The old mill by the river is now a museum.
examples.zh: 河邊的老磨坊現在是一間博物館。

examples.en: My grandfather worked in a paper mill for thirty years.
examples.zh: 我爺爺在造紙廠工作了三十年。

examples.en: She ground the pepper with a small mill.
examples.zh: 她用一個小研磨罐磨了胡椒。

examples.en: Farmers mill the wheat into flour before selling it to bakeries.
examples.zh: 農夫把小麥磨成麵粉後，再將麵粉賣給麵包店。

examples.en: The factory mills rice for local shops.
examples.zh: 這間工廠為當地商店碾米。

examples.en: They mill the coffee beans just before brewing.
examples.zh: 他們在沖泡前才把咖啡豆磨碎。

examples.en: The miners wore helmets with lights on them.
examples.zh: 礦工戴著附有燈的安全帽。

examples.en: My great-grandfather was a coal miner who worked deep underground.
examples.zh: 我的曾祖父曾是一名在地下深處工作的煤礦工人。

examples.en: The miners came out of the tunnel after a long shift.
examples.zh: 礦工們結束長時間的輪班工作後，從坑道裡走了出來。

examples.en: Milk is a good source of minerals such as calcium.
examples.zh: 牛奶是鈣等礦物質的良好來源。

examples.en: The region is rich in minerals like copper and iron.
examples.zh: 這個地區蘊藏豐富的銅和鐵等礦物。

examples.en: We collected different minerals during the field trip.
examples.zh: 我們在校外教學時蒐集了不同的礦石。

examples.en: I always carry a bottle of mineral water.
examples.zh: 我總是隨身帶一瓶礦泉水。

examples.en: The cream contains mineral oil and vitamin E.
examples.zh: 這款乳霜含有礦物油和維他命 E。

examples.en: Mineral resources are limited on this small island.
examples.zh: 這座小島的礦產資源很有限。

examples.en: You must study a minimum of two hours every night.
examples.zh: 你每晚至少要讀兩個小時的書。

examples.en: Keep your expenses to a minimum this month.
examples.zh: 這個月請把開銷降到最低。

examples.en: The minimum for this online order is thirty dollars.
examples.zh: 這筆網路訂單的最低金額是三十元。

examples.en: The minimum age for this ride is twelve.
examples.zh: 這項遊樂設施的最低年齡限制是十二歲。

examples.en: Workers are paid at least the minimum wage.
examples.zh: 員工的薪資至少要達到最低工資。

examples.en: A minimum score of sixty is needed to pass.
examples.zh: 要及格需要最低六十分。

examples.en: The minister of education visited our school yesterday.
examples.zh: 教育部長昨天來參觀了我們學校。

examples.en: The minister answered questions from reporters about the new education policy.
examples.zh: 部長回答了記者關於新教育政策的提問。

examples.en: The minister gave a short talk at the church.
examples.zh: 牧師在教堂裡做了簡短的講道。

examples.en: Nurses minister to patients day and night.
examples.zh: 護理師日夜照顧病患。

examples.en: Volunteers ministered to the families after the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，志工協助照顧受災的家庭。

examples.en: She ministers to the elderly at the care center.
examples.zh: 她在照護中心服務長者。

examples.en: The Ministry of Health announced a new flu program.
examples.zh: 衛生部宣布了一項新的流感計畫。

examples.en: My aunt works at the Ministry of Finance.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在財政部工作。

examples.en: He entered the ministry after finishing his studies.
examples.zh: 他完成學業後就投入了神職工作。

examples.en: The twins were full of mischief at the party.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎在派對上調皮搗蛋。

examples.en: The puppy got into mischief while we were out.
examples.zh: 我們外出時，小狗到處惹事。

examples.en: He smiled with mischief in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他眼裡帶著頑皮的神情笑了。

examples.en: I felt miserable after losing my wallet on the trip.
examples.zh: 旅途中弄丟錢包讓我覺得很難受。

examples.en: It was a cold, wet and miserable afternoon.
examples.zh: 那是個又冷又濕、令人心情低落的下午。

examples.en: They lived in miserable conditions for several months.
examples.zh: 他們在惡劣的環境中生活了好幾個月。

examples.en: He had the misfortune to miss the last train.
examples.zh: 他不幸錯過了最後一班火車。

examples.en: The family bravely faced one misfortune after another.
examples.zh: 這個家庭勇敢地面對一個接一個的不幸。

examples.en: It was our misfortune that it rained all week.
examples.zh: 很不幸，整個星期都在下雨。

examples.en: The sign was wrong and misled many drivers.
examples.zh: 這個標誌有誤，誤導了許多駕駛人。

examples.en: Do not mislead customers with false advertising.
examples.zh: 不要用不實廣告誤導顧客。

examples.en: His polite answer may mislead you about the real situation.
examples.zh: 他客氣的回答可能會讓你誤會真實的情況。

examples.en: I think you misunderstood my question about the homework deadline.
examples.zh: 我想你誤會了我關於作業截止期限的問題。

examples.en: Please do not misunderstand me; I am only trying to help.
examples.zh: 請不要誤會我，我只是想幫忙。

examples.en: Many tourists misunderstand the local custom of removing shoes indoors.
examples.zh: 許多遊客會誤解當地進屋脫鞋的習俗。

examples.en: Doctors suggest moderate exercise three times a week.
examples.zh: 醫師建議每週適度運動三次。

examples.en: The hotel offers rooms at moderate prices.
examples.zh: 這間飯店提供價格適中的房間。

examples.en: She holds moderate views on most topics.
examples.zh: 她對大多數議題都抱持溫和的看法。

examples.en: You should moderate your use of salt and sugar.
examples.zh: 你應該節制鹽和糖的攝取。

examples.en: The teacher will moderate the class discussion.
examples.zh: 老師將主持班上的討論。

examples.en: Cloud cover helps moderate the temperature at night.
examples.zh: 雲層有助於緩和夜間的氣溫。

senses.zh: 謙虛的；樸素的；幅度不大的

examples.en: He is modest about his success in the contest.
examples.zh: 他對自己在比賽中的成功很謙虛。

examples.en: They live in a modest house near the station.
examples.zh: 他們住在車站附近一間樸素的房子裡。

examples.en: The store reported a modest increase in sales.
examples.zh: 這家店的銷售額有小幅成長。

examples.en: Her modesty made everyone like her even more.
examples.zh: 她的謙虛讓大家更喜歡她。

examples.en: He accepted the prize with great modesty.
examples.zh: 他謙遜地接下了獎項。

examples.en: Modesty is an important value in many cultures.
examples.zh: 謙虛在許多文化中都是重要的價值。

examples.en: The monitor on my desk is too bright.
examples.zh: 我桌上的螢幕太亮了。

examples.en: The nurse checked the heart monitor every hour.
examples.zh: 護理師每小時檢查一次心率監測器。

examples.en: Our class monitor collects the homework each morning.
examples.zh: 我們的班長每天早上收作業。

examples.en: Scientists monitor the volcano all year round.
examples.zh: 科學家全年監測這座火山。

examples.en: Parents should monitor how long kids spend online.
examples.zh: 家長應該留意孩子上網的時間。

examples.en: The app helps you monitor your spending.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式能幫你追蹤你的花費。

examples.en: We took a photo in front of the national monument.
examples.zh: 我們在國家紀念碑前拍了照。

examples.en: The old bridge is a historic monument of the city.
examples.zh: 這座老橋是這座城市的歷史古蹟。

examples.en: A stone monument stands on the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 山頂上矗立著一座石製紀念碑。

examples.en: The room is cheap; moreover, it is close to the station.
examples.zh: 這個房間很便宜，而且離車站很近。

examples.en: He is smart. Moreover, he works very hard.
examples.zh: 他很聰明，而且工作非常努力。

examples.en: The food was delicious, and moreover, the service was excellent.
examples.zh: 食物很美味，此外服務也很棒。

senses.zh: 激勵；激發動機；使有幹勁

examples.en: A good teacher knows how to motivate students.
examples.zh: 好老師懂得如何激勵學生。

examples.en: The bonus is meant to motivate employees to work harder.
examples.zh: 這筆獎金是為了激勵員工更加努力。

examples.en: What motivated you to learn the guitar?
examples.zh: 是什麼讓你想學吉他？

examples.en: She lost her motivation to study after the long holiday.
examples.zh: 長假過後，她失去了念書的動力。

examples.en: Money is not the only motivation for working here.
examples.zh: 金錢不是在這裡工作的唯一動機。

examples.en: A kind word from the coach gave the team new motivation.
examples.zh: 教練的一句鼓勵給了球隊新的動力。

examples.en: Taiwan is a small but mountainous island.
examples.zh: 台灣是一座小而多山的島嶼。

examples.en: The train goes through a mountainous area in the east.
examples.zh: 火車穿越東部的山區。

examples.en: Traveling through mountainous areas can make some passengers feel carsick.
examples.zh: 行經山區可能會讓部分乘客暈車。

senses.zh: 泥濘的；沾滿泥巴的；混濁的

examples.en: Please take off your muddy shoes at the door.
examples.zh: 請在門口脫掉你沾滿泥巴的鞋子。

examples.en: The path was muddy after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，小路變得很泥濘。

examples.en: The river looks muddy after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，這條河看起來很混濁。

examples.en: The school offers multiple courses in art, music, and science.
examples.zh: 學校提供多門藝術、音樂和科學課程。

examples.en: He was hurt in multiple places in the accident.
examples.zh: 他在事故中多處受傷。

examples.en: The app lets you log in on multiple devices.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式讓你能在多部裝置上登入。

examples.en: Twelve is a multiple of three, but fourteen is not.
examples.zh: 十二是三的倍數，但十四不是。

examples.en: Ten is a common multiple of two and five.
examples.zh: 十是二和五的公倍數。

examples.en: Students must list every multiple of five below thirty.
examples.zh: 學生必須列出所有小於三十的五的倍數。

examples.en: The detective in the novel finally found the murderer.
examples.zh: 小說裡的偵探終於找出了兇手。

examples.en: Readers are curious about who the murderer is.
examples.zh: 讀者很好奇兇手到底是誰。

examples.en: The police are searching for the murderer in the mystery series.
examples.zh: 在這部推理劇中，警方正在追查兇手。

examples.en: A soft murmur filled the library as students discussed their projects.
examples.zh: 學生討論專題時，圖書館裡充滿輕聲細語。

examples.en: We heard the murmur of the stream behind the hotel.
examples.zh: 我們聽見飯店後方溪水的潺潺聲。

examples.en: There was a murmur of approval from the audience.
examples.zh: 觀眾發出了表示贊同的低語聲。

examples.en: She murmured a thank-you and left the room.
examples.zh: 她低聲說了謝謝就離開了房間。

examples.en: The baby murmured in her sleep while her mother watched nearby.
examples.zh: 媽媽在旁看著寶寶時，寶寶在睡夢中喃喃出聲。

examples.en: He murmured something to the waiter before leaving the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在離開餐廳前，對服務生小聲說了些話。

examples.en: We have a mutual respect for each other.
examples.zh: 我們互相尊重。

examples.en: Tom and I met through a mutual friend.
examples.zh: 我和湯姆是透過共同的朋友認識的。

examples.en: The two companies ended the deal by mutual agreement.
examples.zh: 兩家公司經雙方同意終止了合約。

examples.en: A mysterious package arrived at our door this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有個神秘的包裹送到我們家門口。

examples.en: The old house has a mysterious past.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子有著神秘的過去。

examples.en: She gave a mysterious smile and said nothing.
examples.zh: 她露出神秘的微笑，什麼也沒說。

examples.en: Only one student was absent, namely Tom.
examples.zh: 只有一位學生缺席，也就是湯姆。

examples.en: We need two things, namely time and money.
examples.zh: 我們需要兩樣東西，也就是時間和金錢。

examples.en: The course covers three skills, namely reading, writing and speaking.
examples.zh: 這門課涵蓋三項技能，即閱讀、寫作和口說。

examples.en: The school donated winter coats to needy families.
examples.zh: 學校捐贈冬季外套給貧困的家庭。

examples.en: Many needy students receive free lunches through the school meal program.
examples.zh: 許多清寒學生透過學校的供餐計畫獲得免費午餐。

examples.en: The charity helps needy people in our community.
examples.zh: 這個慈善團體幫助我們社區裡需要幫助的人。

senses.zh: 疏忽；忽視；疏於照料；忘了做

examples.en: Don't neglect your health when you are busy.
examples.zh: 忙碌時也別忽視自己的健康。

examples.en: He neglected to lock the door before leaving.
examples.zh: 他離開前忘了鎖門。

examples.en: The garden was neglected for years after its owner moved away.
examples.zh: 花園主人搬走後，這座花園就疏於照料了好幾年。

examples.en: The old building fell into neglect after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，這棟老建築因疏於維護而逐漸荒廢。

examples.en: The accident was caused by neglect of safety rules.
examples.zh: 這起意外是因為忽視安全規定所造成的。

examples.en: Years of neglect left the park in poor condition.
examples.zh: 多年的疏於管理讓公園狀況很差。

examples.en: The two companies will negotiate a new contract next week.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司下週將協商新的合約。

examples.en: I tried to negotiate a lower price for the sofa.
examples.zh: 我試著為這張沙發談一個較低的價格。

examples.en: Workers negotiated with the manager about their hours.
examples.zh: 員工和經理協商了工作時數的問題。

examples.en: The test was hard; nevertheless, most students passed.
examples.zh: 考試很難，儘管如此，大多數學生還是及格了。

examples.en: It was raining. Nevertheless, we went to the park.
examples.zh: 當時在下雨，儘管如此我們還是去了公園。

examples.en: He was tired but nevertheless finished his report.
examples.zh: 他很累，卻還是把報告寫完了。

examples.en: I woke up from a terrible nightmare at midnight.
examples.zh: 我半夜從一場可怕的惡夢中驚醒。

examples.en: Traffic in the city center is a nightmare at five o'clock.
examples.zh: 五點的市中心交通簡直是一場惡夢。

examples.en: Moving to a new house can be a nightmare.
examples.zh: 搬到新家可能是一件很折騰的事。

examples.en: Helping others is a noble thing to do.
examples.zh: 幫助別人是一件高尚的事。

examples.en: He came from a noble family in the old country.
examples.zh: 他出身於故國的一個貴族家庭。

examples.en: The nurse has a noble spirit of service.
examples.zh: 這位護理師有著崇高的服務精神。

examples.en: The nobles lived in large castles surrounded by high stone walls.
examples.zh: 貴族們住在四周有高大石牆環繞的大城堡裡。

examples.en: Many nobles attended the royal ball to celebrate the prince's birthday.
examples.zh: 許多貴族出席了慶祝王子生日的皇家舞會。

examples.en: In the story, a noble helped the poor farmer.
examples.zh: 故事中，一位貴族幫助了貧窮的農夫。

senses.zh: 胡說；無意義的話；荒唐的事

examples.en: Don't talk nonsense; you know it isn't true.
examples.zh: 別胡說了，你知道那不是真的。

examples.en: The idea that he cheated is complete nonsense.
examples.zh: 說他作弊根本是無稽之談。

examples.en: The little girl sang a funny song full of nonsense words.
examples.zh: 小女孩唱了一首充滿無意義字詞的有趣歌曲。

examples.en: Nowadays, most students use phones to look up words.
examples.zh: 現在大多數學生都用手機查單字。

examples.en: People rarely write personal letters nowadays because email is more convenient.
examples.zh: 現今人們很少寫私人信件，因為電子郵件更方便。

examples.en: Nowadays, you can pay for almost anything with an app.
examples.zh: 如今幾乎什麼東西都能用應用程式付款。

senses.zh: 核能的；原子核的；核子的

examples.en: The museum explains how nuclear power is used to generate electricity.
examples.zh: 這間博物館說明核能如何用來發電。

examples.en: Scientists study nuclear energy in the physics lab.
examples.zh: 科學家在物理實驗室裡研究核能。

examples.en: A nuclear power plant provides electricity to many homes.
examples.zh: 核能發電廠為許多家庭供電。

examples.en: Numerous students signed up for the school trip.
examples.zh: 許多學生報名參加了校外旅行。

examples.en: The museum has received numerous letters from visitors.
examples.zh: 博物館收到了許多來自參觀者的信件。

examples.en: She has visited Japan on numerous occasions.
examples.zh: 她曾多次造訪日本。

examples.en: My little sister goes to a nursery while our parents work.
examples.zh: 爸媽上班時，我妹妹會去托兒所。

examples.en: They painted the nursery yellow before the baby arrived.
examples.zh: 寶寶出生前，他們把育嬰室漆成了黃色。

examples.en: We bought some young trees from a local nursery.
examples.zh: 我們從當地的苗圃買了一些樹苗。

examples.en: The obedient puppy sat down as soon as it was told.
examples.zh: 那隻聽話的小狗一被吩咐就坐下了。

examples.en: Students in this class are quiet and obedient.
examples.zh: 這個班上的學生安靜又守規矩。

examples.en: He was an obedient child who always did his homework.
examples.zh: 他是個乖巧的孩子，總是乖乖寫功課。

examples.en: Does anyone have an objection to the new schedule?
examples.zh: 有人對新的時間表有異議嗎？

examples.en: She raised an objection to the plan at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在會議上對這項計畫提出了異議。

examples.en: My main objection is that the price is too high.
examples.zh: 我主要反對的理由是價格太高了。

examples.en: Our main objective is to finish the project by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們的主要目標是在週五前完成這個專案。

examples.en: The objective of this lesson is to improve your listening.
examples.zh: 這堂課的目的是提升你的聽力。

examples.en: The company set a clear objective for the new year.
examples.zh: 公司為新的一年訂下了明確的目標。

examples.en: A good judge must be objective and fair.
examples.zh: 好的法官必須客觀且公正。

examples.en: The report gives an objective view of the problem.
examples.zh: 這份報告對這個問題提出了客觀的看法。

examples.en: It is hard to stay objective when you know the people involved.
examples.zh: 當你認識當事人時，很難保持客觀。

senses.zh: 觀察；觀測；觀察結果；意見

examples.en: Careful observation helped her find the mistake.
examples.zh: 仔細的觀察幫助她找出了錯誤。

examples.en: The students recorded their observations in a notebook.
examples.zh: 學生們把觀察結果記錄在筆記本裡。

examples.en: That was a clever observation about the story.
examples.zh: 那是對這個故事很聰明的見解。

examples.en: You need a visa to obtain entry to that country.
examples.zh: 你需要簽證才能取得進入那個國家的許可。

examples.en: Where can I obtain a copy of the form?
examples.zh: 我可以在哪裡拿到這份表格？

examples.en: She obtained a high score on the English test.
examples.zh: 她在英文考試中獲得了高分。

examples.en: We have an occasional visit from our grandparents.
examples.zh: 我們偶爾會有祖父母來訪。

examples.en: There will be occasional showers this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午會有零星陣雨。

examples.en: He enjoys an occasional cup of coffee after dinner.
examples.zh: 他喜歡偶爾在晚餐後喝杯咖啡。

examples.en: Please write your name and occupation on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的姓名和職業。

examples.en: Teaching is a rewarding occupation that requires patience and creativity.
examples.zh: 教書是一份需要耐心與創意，也很有成就感的職業。

examples.en: The occupation of the building lasted for three weeks.
examples.zh: 這棟大樓被占用了三個星期。

examples.en: The meeting will occupy most of the morning.
examples.zh: 這場會議會占掉大半個早上。

examples.en: Please do not occupy the seats reserved for the elderly.
examples.zh: 請不要占用保留給長者的座位。

examples.en: Reading books keeps the kids occupied on long trips.
examples.zh: 看書讓孩子們在長途旅行中不會無聊。

examples.en: I hope my joke did not offend anyone.
examples.zh: 我希望我的玩笑沒有冒犯到任何人。

examples.en: Her rude words offended the teacher during the class discussion.
examples.zh: 她在課堂討論時說的無禮話語冒犯了老師。

examples.en: Some people are easily offended by loud music.
examples.zh: 有些人很容易被大聲的音樂惹得不高興。

senses.zh: 冒犯；違規；進攻；進攻陣容

examples.en: I meant no offense by what I said.
examples.zh: 我說那些話並沒有冒犯的意思。

examples.en: Parking here is an offense and you may get a ticket.
examples.zh: 在這裡停車是違規行為，你可能會被開罰單。

examples.en: Our team's offense scored three goals in the first half.
examples.zh: 我們隊的進攻球員在上半場攻進了三球。

senses.zh: 冒犯的；無禮的；令人不快的

examples.en: The comment was offensive to many people.
examples.zh: 這個評論讓許多人覺得受到冒犯。

examples.en: Please do not use offensive language in class.
examples.zh: 請不要在課堂上使用不雅的言詞。

examples.en: There was an offensive smell coming from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房傳來一股令人不快的氣味。

examples.en: We went to the opera for my mother's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們為了慶祝媽媽的生日去看了歌劇。

examples.en: The opera house is in the center of the city.
examples.zh: 歌劇院位於市中心。

examples.en: She has loved opera since she was a little girl.
examples.zh: 她從小就喜愛歌劇。

examples.en: Many residents oppose the plan to build a new road.
examples.zh: 許多居民反對興建新道路的計畫。

examples.en: I strongly oppose cutting the art classes.
examples.zh: 我強烈反對削減美術課。

examples.en: Parents opposed the idea of a longer school day.
examples.zh: 家長們反對延長上課時間的想法。

examples.en: You have the option of paying by card or in cash.
examples.zh: 你可以選擇用信用卡或現金付款。

examples.en: The menu has several vegetarian options, including soup and salads.
examples.zh: 菜單上有好幾種素食選擇，包括湯品與沙拉。

examples.en: Taking the train is the cheapest option.
examples.zh: 搭火車是最便宜的選擇。

examples.en: The moon moves in an orbit around the Earth.
examples.zh: 月球沿著軌道繞行地球。

examples.en: The satellite entered orbit after a successful launch from the space center.
examples.zh: 那顆衛星從太空中心成功發射後，進入了軌道。

examples.en: Each planet has its own orbit around the sun.
examples.zh: 每顆行星都有各自繞行太陽的軌道。

examples.en: The Earth orbits the sun once a year.
examples.zh: 地球每年繞太陽一圈。

examples.en: Several satellites orbit the Earth to collect data about the weather.
examples.zh: 好幾顆衛星繞行地球，以蒐集天氣資料。

examples.en: The spacecraft orbited the planet for two months.
examples.zh: 太空船繞著那顆行星運行了兩個月。

examples.en: My brother plays the cello in the school orchestra.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在學校的管弦樂團裡拉大提琴。

examples.en: The orchestra practices every Tuesday evening for its annual concert.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團每週二晚上都為年度音樂會練習。

examples.en: The audience clapped when the orchestra finished the song.
examples.zh: 樂團演奏完這首曲子時，觀眾鼓起掌來。

examples.en: The orphan was raised by his aunt and uncle.
examples.zh: 那名孤兒由他的阿姨和姨丈扶養長大。

examples.en: The charity helps orphans find loving homes.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構協助孤兒找到溫暖的家。

examples.en: She became an orphan at the age of five.
examples.zh: 她在五歲時成了孤兒。

senses.zh: 否則；除此之外；以別的方式

examples.en: Hurry up; otherwise, we will miss the bus.
examples.zh: 快點，否則我們會趕不上公車。

examples.en: The room was small but otherwise very nice.
examples.zh: 這個房間雖小，但除此之外都很不錯。

examples.en: Unless told otherwise, please arrive at nine.
examples.zh: 除非另有通知，否則請九點到。

examples.en: We are happy with the outcome of the meeting.
examples.zh: 我們對會議的結果很滿意。

examples.en: The outcome of the game surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 比賽的結果讓所有人都很驚訝。

examples.en: Hard work usually leads to a good outcome.
examples.zh: 努力通常會帶來好的結果。

examples.en: She received an award for her outstanding work.
examples.zh: 她因傑出的表現而獲獎。

examples.en: The restaurant is known for its outstanding service.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以優質的服務聞名。

examples.en: You still have an outstanding bill to pay.
examples.zh: 你還有一筆帳單尚未付清。

examples.en: We sat around an oval table in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 我們圍坐在會議室的橢圓形桌子旁。

examples.en: The mirror has an oval frame made of dark wood.
examples.zh: 這面鏡子有一個深色木製的橢圓形框架。

examples.en: The runners train on an oval track near our school.
examples.zh: 跑者在我們學校附近的橢圓形跑道上訓練。

examples.en: Draw an oval on the paper with your pencil.
examples.zh: 用你的鉛筆在紙上畫一個橢圓形。

examples.en: The garden path forms a large oval.
examples.zh: 花園的小徑形成一個大橢圓。

examples.en: Cut the cloth into an oval to make a small placemat.
examples.zh: 把布剪成橢圓形，做成一張小餐墊。

examples.en: He wore a heavy overcoat on the cold morning.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的早晨，他穿了一件厚重的大衣。

examples.en: She hung her overcoat in the hallway.
examples.zh: 她把大衣掛在走廊上。

examples.en: I need to buy a new overcoat for winter.
examples.zh: 我冬天需要買一件新大衣。

examples.en: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking.
examples.zh: 她努力克服對演講的恐懼。

examples.en: The team overcame many problems to finish the project.
examples.zh: 團隊克服了許多困難才完成這項專案。

examples.en: He was overcome with joy when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 他聽到這個消息時欣喜若狂。

examples.en: It is easy to overlook small mistakes in a long report.
examples.zh: 在長篇報告中很容易忽略小錯誤。

examples.en: Our hotel room overlooks the ocean and a small fishing harbor.
examples.zh: 從我們的飯店房間可以眺望大海和一座小漁港。

examples.en: The teacher decided to overlook his late homework this time.
examples.zh: 老師決定這次不追究他遲交的作業。

examples.en: The snow fell overnight and covered the streets.
examples.zh: 夜裡下了雪，覆蓋了街道。

examples.en: We stayed overnight at my aunt's house.
examples.zh: 我們在阿姨家過了一夜。

examples.en: The store can ship your package overnight for an extra fee.
examples.zh: 只要額外付費，這家店就能將你的包裹隔夜送達。

examples.en: We took an overnight train to the south.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘夜車前往南部。

examples.en: Please pack an overnight bag for the camping trip.
examples.zh: 請為露營之旅準備一個過夜用的包包。

examples.en: The hotel offers an overnight stay at a low price.
examples.zh: 這家飯店以低價提供一晚住宿。

examples.en: The people wanted to overthrow the old government.
examples.zh: 人民想要推翻舊政府。

examples.en: The history textbook explains why the monarchy was overthrown.
examples.zh: 這本歷史課本說明了君主政體被推翻的原因。

examples.en: Rebels tried to overthrow the ruler of the country.
examples.zh: 叛軍試圖推翻該國的統治者。

examples.en: Plants give off oxygen during the day.
examples.zh: 植物在白天會釋放氧氣。

examples.en: Fish take dissolved oxygen from the water through their gills.
examples.zh: 魚透過鰓從水中獲取溶氧。

examples.en: Climbers carry oxygen to help them breathe on the mountain.
examples.zh: 登山客帶著氧氣來幫助自己在山上呼吸。

examples.en: Walk at a slow pace so everyone can keep up.
examples.zh: 走慢一點，讓大家都跟得上。

examples.en: The pace of city life is very fast.
examples.zh: 都市生活的步調非常快。

examples.en: She took two paces forward and stopped.
examples.zh: 她往前走了兩步就停下來。

examples.en: He paced up and down the hallway before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前他在走廊上來回踱步。

examples.en: The coach told us to pace ourselves in the race.
examples.zh: 教練叫我們在比賽中要掌握好自己的步調。

examples.en: My father paced the room while waiting for the call.
examples.zh: 我爸爸在等電話時在房間裡踱步。

examples.en: Press the button on the control panel to start.
examples.zh: 按下控制面板上的按鈕即可啟動。

examples.en: A panel of teachers chose the winner of the contest.
examples.zh: 一個由老師組成的小組選出了比賽的優勝者。

examples.en: The roof is covered with solar panels.
examples.zh: 屋頂上裝滿了太陽能板。

examples.en: The pilot opened his parachute after jumping out.
examples.zh: 飛行員跳出後打開了降落傘。

examples.en: A parachute slows a person's fall by increasing air resistance.
examples.zh: 降落傘透過增加空氣阻力來減緩人的下墜速度。

examples.en: She wore a parachute for her first jump.
examples.zh: 她第一次跳傘時穿戴了降落傘。

examples.en: They parachuted into the field on a sunny morning.
examples.zh: 他們在一個晴朗的早晨跳傘降落到田野上。

examples.en: Supplies were parachuted to the village after floods blocked the roads.
examples.zh: 洪水阻斷道路後，補給品被空投到那個村莊。

examples.en: My uncle likes to parachute for fun.
examples.zh: 我叔叔喜歡跳傘當休閒活動。

examples.en: Please read the first paragraph aloud before answering the questions.
examples.zh: 回答問題前，請先把第一段大聲唸出來。

examples.en: Each paragraph should have one main idea.
examples.zh: 每個段落都應該有一個主旨。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write a short paragraph about our pets.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一小段關於寵物的文字。

senses.zh: 部分的；不完全的；偏愛的

examples.en: Only a partial list of names was posted on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上只貼了部分的名單。

examples.en: We offer a partial refund if you cancel your reservation.
examples.zh: 如果你取消預約，我們會退還部分款項。

examples.en: She is partial to chocolate cake with fresh strawberries.
examples.zh: 她特別偏愛搭配新鮮草莓的巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: The two companies formed a partnership last year.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司在去年建立了合作關係。

examples.en: Their partnership has lasted for over ten years.
examples.zh: 他們的合夥關係已持續十多年。

examples.en: The school works in partnership with local parents.
examples.zh: 學校與當地家長合作。

examples.en: He is a passive student who never asks questions.
examples.zh: 他是個被動的學生，從不發問。

examples.en: Some people take a passive role in group work.
examples.zh: 有些人在小組作業中扮演被動的角色。

examples.en: The sentence is in the passive voice.
examples.zh: 這個句子是被動語態。

examples.en: We had pasta with tomato sauce for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了番茄醬義大利麵。

examples.en: Boil the pasta for about ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把麵煮大約十分鐘。

examples.en: My sister learned to make fresh pasta in Italy.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在義大利學會了做新鮮的麵食。

examples.en: The cat licked its paw after eating.
examples.zh: 貓吃完東西後舔了舔牠的爪子。

examples.en: The dog gave me his paw when I offered a treat.
examples.zh: 我拿點心給那隻狗時，牠把前掌伸給了我。

examples.en: There were small paw prints in the snow.
examples.zh: 雪地上有小小的腳掌印。

examples.en: There is a peculiar smell in this room.
examples.zh: 這個房間裡有一股奇怪的味道。

examples.en: The old man has a peculiar way of talking.
examples.zh: 那位老先生說話的方式很特別。

examples.en: This custom is peculiar to the island.
examples.zh: 這個習俗是這座島特有的。

examples.en: The children peeped through the door to see the gifts.
examples.zh: 孩子們從門縫偷看禮物。

examples.en: She peeped out of the window at the rain.
examples.zh: 她從窗戶往外偷瞄雨景。

examples.en: Do not peep at another student's answers during the test.
examples.zh: 考試時，不要偷看其他同學的答案。

examples.en: Let me have a peep at your new phone.
examples.zh: 讓我偷瞄一下你的新手機。

examples.en: He took a quick peep inside the box.
examples.zh: 他很快往盒子裡瞄了一眼。

examples.en: I had a peep at the cake before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前我偷看了一下蛋糕。

examples.en: Teenagers often listen to their peers when choosing what to wear.
examples.zh: 青少年在選擇穿著時，常會聽同儕的意見。

examples.en: She is respected by her peers at work.
examples.zh: 她受到同事們的敬重。

examples.en: Students learn a lot from their peers.
examples.zh: 學生從同儕身上學到很多。

examples.en: He peered at the small words on the sign.
examples.zh: 他瞇著眼看招牌上的小字。

examples.en: She peered through the fog to find the road.
examples.zh: 她透過濃霧努力看清路。

examples.en: The boy peered into the dark room.
examples.zh: 男孩朝漆黑的房間裡凝視。

examples.en: The penalty for late homework is ten points.
examples.zh: 遲交作業的處罰是扣十分。

examples.en: You will pay a penalty if you cancel the ticket.
examples.zh: 如果你退票，就要支付一筆違約金。

examples.en: The player scored from a penalty kick.
examples.zh: 那位球員靠罰球得分。

examples.en: About fifty percent of the class passed the test.
examples.zh: 班上大約有百分之五十的人通過了考試。

examples.en: The store is offering twenty percent off on all shoes.
examples.zh: 這家店的所有鞋子都打八折。

examples.en: Only ten percent of the students walk to school.

examples.zh: 謝謝你迅速回覆我的電子郵件。

examples.en: The bus driver is always prompt and never late.
examples.zh: 這位公車司機總是很準時，從不遲到。

examples.en: We need prompt action to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要迅速採取行動來解決問題。

examples.en: The teacher prompted him with the first word of the answer.
examples.zh: 老師用答案的第一個字提示他。

examples.en: The smell of bread prompted me to go into the shop.
examples.zh: 麵包的香味讓我走進了那家店。

examples.en: A sudden noise prompted everyone to look up.
examples.zh: 一陣突如其來的聲響讓大家都抬起頭來。

examples.en: A prompt on the screen asks you to enter your name.
examples.zh: 螢幕上的提示要求你輸入姓名。

examples.en: The writing prompt for today's class is about summer.
examples.zh: 今天課堂的寫作題目是關於夏天。

examples.en: Click the prompt to continue to the next page.
examples.zh: 點選提示以繼續前往下一頁。

examples.en: Her English pronunciation is clear and easy to understand.
examples.zh: 她的英文發音清楚又好懂。

examples.en: Can you check the pronunciation of this word in the dictionary?
examples.zh: 你可以查一下字典裡這個字的發音嗎？

examples.en: The teacher helped us practice the pronunciation of difficult words.
examples.zh: 老師幫我們練習困難單字的發音。

examples.en: The manager accepted our proposal for a new project.
examples.zh: 經理接受了我們新專案的提案。

examples.en: The city council discussed a proposal to build a new park.
examples.zh: 市議會討論了興建新公園的提案。

examples.en: She said yes to his marriage proposal.
examples.zh: 她答應了他的求婚。

examples.en: The small town began to prosper after the factory opened.
examples.zh: 工廠開張後，這個小鎮開始繁榮起來。

examples.en: Her business prospered because of good service.
examples.zh: 她的生意因為服務良好而興旺。

examples.en: Plants prosper in warm and sunny weather.
examples.zh: 植物在溫暖晴朗的天氣裡長得很茂盛。

examples.en: The new railway brought prosperity to the village.
examples.zh: 新鐵路為這個村莊帶來了繁榮。

examples.en: We wish you health and prosperity in the new year.
examples.zh: 祝你新年健康興旺。

examples.en: The country enjoyed years of peace and prosperity.
examples.zh: 這個國家享有多年的和平與繁榮。

examples.en: Taipei is a modern and prosperous city.
examples.zh: 台北是一座現代又繁榮的城市。

examples.en: His uncle runs a prosperous restaurant near the station.
examples.zh: 他叔叔在車站附近經營一家生意興隆的餐廳。

examples.en: We hope for a happy and prosperous future.
examples.zh: 我們期盼一個快樂又富足的未來。

examples.en: Eggs and fish are good sources of protein.
examples.zh: 蛋和魚是蛋白質的良好來源。

examples.en: Athletes need enough protein to build strong muscles.
examples.zh: 運動員需要足夠的蛋白質來增強肌肉。

examples.en: Beans are a cheap source of protein for many families.
examples.zh: 豆類是許多家庭取得蛋白質的便宜來源。

examples.en: Students held a peaceful protest against the new school fee.
examples.zh: 學生針對新的學費舉行和平抗議。

examples.en: The company ignored the protest from its customers.
examples.zh: 公司無視顧客的抗議。

examples.en: She signed the letter as a protest against the plan.
examples.zh: 她簽了這封信，作為對該計畫的抗議。

examples.en: Residents protested when the park was closed.
examples.zh: 公園關閉時，居民提出抗議。

examples.en: Many parents protested against the longer school day.
examples.zh: 許多家長反對延長在校時間。

examples.en: He protested that the price was too high.
examples.zh: 他抗議價格太高了。

examples.en: Stress can cause both physical and psychological problems.
examples.zh: 壓力可能造成身體與心理上的問題。

examples.en: The school offers psychological support for students.
examples.zh: 學校為學生提供心理輔導。

examples.en: Winning the game gave the team a psychological boost.
examples.zh: 贏得比賽讓球隊在心理上獲得鼓舞。

examples.en: The psychologist asked the boy how he felt at school.
examples.zh: 心理師問那個男孩在學校的感受如何。

examples.en: My aunt works as a psychologist at a hospital.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在一家醫院擔任心理師。

examples.en: A famous psychologist will give a talk at our university.
examples.zh: 一位著名的心理學家將在我們大學演講。

examples.en: She decided to study psychology at university.
examples.zh: 她決定在大學主修心理學。

examples.en: This book explains the psychology of shopping.
examples.zh: 這本書解釋了購物的心理。

examples.en: Child psychology helps teachers understand young students.
examples.zh: 兒童心理學能幫助老師了解年幼的學生。

examples.en: The publication of her first novel made her famous.
examples.zh: 她第一本小說的出版讓她聲名大噪。

examples.en: This magazine is a monthly publication for teenagers.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌是給青少年看的月刊。

examples.en: The library keeps old publications in a special room.
examples.zh: 圖書館把舊的出版品存放在一間特別的房間。

examples.en: The film got a lot of publicity before its release.
examples.zh: 這部電影在上映前獲得大量宣傳。

examples.en: Good publicity can help a small shop attract customers.
examples.zh: 好的宣傳能幫小店吸引顧客。

examples.en: The singer does not like the publicity that comes with fame.
examples.zh: 這位歌手不喜歡成名帶來的媒體曝光。

examples.en: The company will publish her new book next spring.
examples.zh: 這家公司將在明年春天出版她的新書。

examples.en: Scientists must publish their results in a journal.
examples.zh: 科學家必須把研究結果發表在期刊上。

examples.en: The newspaper published a photo of the new bridge.
examples.zh: 報紙刊登了一張新橋的照片。

examples.en: The publisher sent us a free copy of the dictionary.
examples.zh: 出版社寄給我們一本免費的字典。

examples.en: She works for a children's book publisher in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她任職於台北一家童書出版社。

examples.en: The author met her publisher to discuss the cover.
examples.zh: 作者與她的出版商見面討論封面。

examples.en: She wants to pursue a career in medicine.
examples.zh: 她想從事醫學方面的職業。

examples.en: He moved abroad to pursue his dream of becoming a chef.
examples.zh: 他搬到國外追求成為廚師的夢想。

examples.en: The dog pursued the ball across the yard.
examples.zh: 狗追著球跑過院子。

examples.en: The pursuit of happiness is important to everyone.
examples.zh: 追求快樂對每個人都很重要。

examples.en: Police cars joined the pursuit of the stolen bike.
examples.zh: 警車加入了追捕那輛失竊腳踏車的行列。

examples.en: Fishing is his favorite leisure pursuit.
examples.zh: 釣魚是他最喜愛的休閒嗜好。

examples.en: The two sisters had a quarrel about who broke the cup.
examples.zh: 兩姊妹為了誰打破杯子而吵了一架。

examples.en: Their quarrel ended when Tom said sorry.
examples.zh: 湯姆道歉後，他們的爭吵就結束了。

examples.en: A small quarrel over money can hurt a friendship.
examples.zh: 為了錢而起的小口角可能傷害友誼。

examples.en: My brothers often quarrel over the TV remote.
examples.zh: 我的哥哥們常為了電視遙控器吵架。

examples.en: Please do not quarrel in front of the children.
examples.zh: 請不要在孩子面前吵架。

examples.en: They quarreled about where to go on vacation.
examples.zh: 他們為了度假要去哪裡而爭吵。

examples.en: Grandma made a warm quilt for my bed.
examples.zh: 奶奶為我的床縫了一條暖和的被子。

examples.en: The colorful quilt hangs on the wall of the shop.
examples.zh: 那條色彩繽紛的拼布被掛在店裡的牆上。

examples.en: I pulled the quilt up to my chin and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 我把被子拉到下巴就睡著了。

examples.en: The airport uses radar to track planes in the sky.
examples.zh: 機場使用雷達追蹤天上的飛機。

examples.en: The weather radar shows a storm moving toward the coast.
examples.zh: 氣象雷達顯示有風暴正朝海岸移動。

examples.en: The ship's radar warned the crew about a nearby island.
examples.zh: 船上的雷達警告船員附近有座島。

examples.en: He slammed the door in a rage.
examples.zh: 他怒氣沖沖地摔上了門。

examples.en: Her face turned red with rage when she saw the broken window.
examples.zh: 她看到破掉的窗戶時氣得滿臉通紅。

examples.en: The coach tried to control his rage after the loss.
examples.zh: 教練試著在輸球後控制自己的怒氣。

examples.en: Heavy rainfall caused traffic problems in the city.
examples.zh: 大雨造成市區的交通問題。

examples.en: The island gets a lot of rainfall in summer.
examples.zh: 這座島的夏季降雨量很大。

examples.en: Farmers need enough rainfall to grow rice.
examples.zh: 農夫需要足夠的雨量來種稻米。

examples.en: My mother added raisins to the bread.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在麵包裡加了葡萄乾。

examples.en: A raisin is a dried grape often used in bread.
examples.zh: 葡萄乾是葡萄乾燥後製成的，常用來製作麵包。

examples.en: I like cookies with raisins and nuts.
examples.zh: 我喜歡加了葡萄乾和堅果的餅乾。

examples.en: Setting a realistic goal helps you stay motivated.
examples.zh: 設定切合實際的目標能讓你保持動力。

examples.en: The painting of the lake looks very realistic.
examples.zh: 這幅湖的畫看起來非常逼真。

examples.en: Be realistic: we cannot finish this project in one day.
examples.zh: 現實一點：我們不可能一天就完成這個專案。

examples.en: As a teenager, she was a bit of a rebel.
examples.zh: 她青少年時期有點叛逆。

examples.en: The rebels in the story fight against the cruel king.
examples.zh: 故事中的反抗者對抗殘酷的國王。

examples.en: My little brother is a rebel who never follows the rules.
examples.zh: 我弟弟是個從不守規矩的叛逆者。

examples.en: Teenagers sometimes rebel against their parents' rules about screen time.
examples.zh: 青少年有時會反抗父母對螢幕使用時間的規定。

examples.en: The workers rebelled against the unfair rules.
examples.zh: 員工反抗不公平的規定。

examples.en: He rebelled by wearing his hair long.
examples.zh: 他留長頭髮來表示叛逆。

examples.en: I cannot recall where I put my keys.
examples.zh: 我想不起來鑰匙放在哪裡。

examples.en: The company recalled thousands of faulty cars.
examples.zh: 這家公司召回了數千輛有瑕疵的汽車。

examples.en: Can you recall the name of the restaurant we visited?
examples.zh: 你還記得我們去過的那家餐廳叫什麼名字嗎？

examples.en: She has an amazing recall of names and faces.
examples.zh: 她對名字和長相的記憶力驚人。

examples.en: The store announced a recall of the toy.
examples.zh: 商店宣布召回這項玩具。

examples.en: His recall of the trip was very clear.
examples.zh: 他對那趟旅行的回想非常清楚。

examples.en: Please leave your bag at the hotel reception.
examples.zh: 請把你的包包留在飯店櫃檯。

examples.en: They held a wedding reception for two hundred guests.
examples.zh: 他們為兩百位賓客舉辦了婚宴。

examples.en: The phone has poor reception in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這支手機在山上的收訊很差。

examples.en: This recipe needs only three eggs and some flour.
examples.zh: 這份食譜只需要三顆蛋和一些麵粉。

examples.en: My grandmother gave me her recipe for dumplings.
examples.zh: 奶奶把她包水餃的食譜給了我。

examples.en: Hard work is the recipe for success.
examples.zh: 努力是成功的秘訣。

examples.en: The phone uses facial recognition to unlock the screen.
examples.zh: 這支手機使用臉部辨識來解鎖螢幕。

examples.en: She received public recognition for her hard work.
examples.zh: 她的努力獲得公開表揚。

examples.en: The school gave him recognition for helping others.
examples.zh: 學校因他樂於助人而表揚他。

examples.en: The doctor said her recovery was going well.
examples.zh: 醫生說她的康復狀況良好。

examples.en: The country's economic recovery took several years.
examples.zh: 這個國家的經濟復甦花了好幾年。

examples.en: Rest and sleep are important for a quick recovery.
examples.zh: 休息與睡眠對快速恢復很重要。

examples.en: The park offers many places for outdoor recreation.
examples.zh: 這座公園有許多戶外休閒的場所。

examples.en: Reading is his favorite form of recreation.
examples.zh: 閱讀是他最喜愛的休閒方式。

examples.en: The school has a recreation room with a ping-pong table.
examples.zh: 學校有一間設有桌球檯的休閒室。

examples.en: There was a big reduction in the price of laptops.
examples.zh: 筆記型電腦的價格大幅降低。

examples.en: The city wants a reduction in traffic noise.
examples.zh: 市政府希望降低交通噪音。

examples.en: Students can get a reduction on museum tickets.
examples.zh: 學生購買博物館門票可享折扣。

examples.en: Please refer to page ten for the answer.
examples.zh: 請參考第十頁找答案。

examples.en: The teacher referred to the map during the lesson.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上提到那張地圖。

examples.en: My doctor referred me to a heart specialist.
examples.zh: 我的醫生把我轉介給一位心臟專科醫師。

examples.en: You can use a dictionary as a reference when you write.
examples.zh: 你寫作時可以把字典當作參考。

examples.en: He made no reference to the meeting in his email.
examples.zh: 他在電子郵件裡完全沒有提到那場會議。

examples.en: My former boss agreed to be my reference for the job.
examples.zh: 我的前任主管同意擔任我這份工作的推薦人。

examples.en: The lake reflected the mountains like a mirror.
examples.zh: 湖面像鏡子一樣映出群山。

examples.en: Her smile reflects how happy she is.
examples.zh: 她的笑容反映出她有多快樂。

examples.en: Take a moment to reflect on what you have learned.
examples.zh: 花點時間思考你學到了什麼。

examples.en: I saw my reflection in the shop window.
examples.zh: 我在商店櫥窗裡看見自己的倒影。

examples.en: His grades are a reflection of his hard work.
examples.zh: 他的成績反映出他的努力。

examples.en: After some reflection, she changed her mind.
examples.zh: 經過一番反思，她改變了主意。

examples.en: The government promised a reform of the school system.
examples.zh: 政府承諾要改革教育制度。

examples.en: The company announced a major reform of its rules.
examples.zh: 公司宣布對規定進行重大改革。

examples.en: Tax reform was a big topic in the news.
examples.zh: 稅制改革是新聞上的熱門話題。

examples.en: The city plans to reform its bus service.
examples.zh: 市府計畫改善公車服務。

examples.en: The new manager reformed the way the team works.
examples.zh: 新經理改革了團隊的工作方式。

examples.en: He reformed after he left his old friends.
examples.zh: 他離開舊朋友後就改過自新了。

examples.en: The refugees were given food and a place to sleep.
examples.zh: 難民獲得食物與睡覺的地方。

examples.en: Many refugee families lost their homes in the war.
examples.zh: 許多難民家庭在戰爭中失去了家園。

examples.en: Volunteers helped the refugee children start school.
examples.zh: 志工協助難民兒童開始上學。

examples.en: His refusal to help with the project surprised everyone in class.
examples.zh: 他拒絕協助這個專題，讓班上每個人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The company's refusal to hire her was a serious disappointment.
examples.zh: 這家公司拒絕聘用她，讓她大失所望。

examples.en: The shop's refusal to give a refund made us angry.
examples.zh: 商店不肯退款讓我們很生氣。

examples.en: I am writing regarding your order from last week.
examples.zh: 我寫這封信，是要談你上週的訂單。

examples.en: Do you have any questions regarding the homework?
examples.zh: 你對這份作業有任何問題嗎？

examples.en: The school sent a notice regarding the trip.
examples.zh: 學校發了一份有關校外旅行的通知。

examples.en: You must register online before the class begins.
examples.zh: 你必須在課程開始前上網註冊。

examples.en: Please register your car at the local office.
examples.zh: 請到當地辦公室登記你的汽車。

examples.en: Over two hundred students registered for the camp.
examples.zh: 有兩百多位學生報名參加營隊。

examples.en: The teacher marked my name in the class register.
examples.zh: 老師在班級點名簿上標記了我的名字。

examples.en: The cashier put the money in the cash register.
examples.zh: 收銀員把錢放進收銀機。

examples.en: Please sign the hotel register at the front desk.
examples.zh: 請在櫃檯的住宿登記簿上簽名。

examples.en: Online registration for the course starts on Monday.
examples.zh: 這門課程的線上報名星期一開始。

examples.en: Please bring your car registration to the office.
examples.zh: 請把你的汽車登記證帶到辦公室。

examples.en: The registration fee is fifty dollars, including all course materials.
examples.zh: 註冊費為五十元，包含所有課程教材。

examples.en: The government regulates the price of electricity.
examples.zh: 政府管制電價。

examples.en: A thermostat helps regulate the temperature in the room.
examples.zh: 恆溫器有助於調節房間的溫度。

examples.en: Rules regulate how much noise people can make at night.
examples.zh: 規定限制了人們晚上可以製造的噪音量。

examples.en: School regulations say that students must wear uniforms.
examples.zh: 校規規定學生必須穿制服。

examples.en: The new regulation protects workers from long hours.
examples.zh: 這項新法規保護員工不必長時間工作。

examples.en: Safety regulations require everyone to wear a helmet.
examples.zh: 安全規定要求每個人都要戴安全帽。

examples.en: Yoga is a good way to find relaxation after work.
examples.zh: 瑜伽是下班後放鬆的好方法。

examples.en: Soft music can help with relaxation after a stressful workday.
examples.zh: 在工作壓力大的一天結束後，輕柔的音樂有助於放鬆。

examples.en: We need some relaxation after the long exam week.
examples.zh: 漫長的考試週之後，我們需要放鬆一下。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medicine to relieve the patient's persistent headache.
examples.zh: 醫生開藥來緩解病人持續的頭痛。

examples.en: A warm bath can relieve stress after a long day.
examples.zh: 泡個熱水澡可以舒緩一天下來的壓力。

examples.en: The good news relieved her worry about the test.
examples.zh: 這個好消息減輕了她對考試的擔心。

examples.en: He was reluctant to speak in front of the class.
examples.zh: 他不太願意在全班面前發言。

examples.en: My sister was reluctant to try the new food.
examples.zh: 我妹妹不太願意嘗試新食物。

examples.en: The manager gave a reluctant smile and signed the paper.
examples.zh: 經理勉強地笑了笑，在文件上簽了名。

examples.en: His remark about the food made the cook angry.
examples.zh: 他對食物的評論讓廚師很生氣。

examples.en: The teacher made a kind remark about my essay.
examples.zh: 老師對我的作文給了一句親切的評語。

examples.en: She ignored the rude remark and kept walking.
examples.zh: 她不理會那句無禮的話，繼續往前走。

examples.en: Many visitors remarked on the beautiful garden.
examples.zh: 許多遊客談到那座美麗的花園。

examples.en: "It's getting late," he remarked as he checked his watch.
examples.zh: 他看著手錶說：「時間不早了。」

examples.en: She remarked that the room was too cold.
examples.zh: 她說房間太冷了。

senses.zh: 卓越的；驚人的；值得注意的

examples.en: The young pianist made remarkable progress this year.
examples.zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家今年有驚人的進步。

examples.en: It is remarkable that no one was hurt.
examples.zh: 沒有人受傷，真是令人驚訝。

examples.en: The museum has a remarkable collection of old maps.
examples.zh: 這座博物館收藏了一批了不起的古地圖。

examples.en: Hot tea with honey is a good remedy for a sore throat.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜熱茶是治喉嚨痛的好方法。

examples.en: The city is looking for a remedy to the traffic problem.
examples.zh: 市府正在尋找解決塞車問題的辦法。

examples.en: My grandmother knows many natural remedies for common cold symptoms.
examples.zh: 我奶奶知道許多緩解常見感冒症狀的天然療法。

examples.en: You need to renew your library card every year.
examples.zh: 你每年都需要更新圖書證。

examples.en: I will renew my passport before the trip.
examples.zh: 我會在旅行前更新護照。

examples.en: The two countries renewed their friendship after years of difficult relations.
examples.zh: 兩國在多年的關係緊張之後，重新建立了友誼。

examples.en: Repetition is the key to learning new words.
examples.zh: 反覆練習是學習新單字的關鍵。

examples.en: The teacher warned us against a repetition of the same mistake.
examples.zh: 老師提醒我們，別再犯同樣的錯。

examples.en: Too much repetition in a speech can be boring.
examples.zh: 演講中太多重複的內容會很無聊。

examples.en: Every class has equal representation on the student council.
examples.zh: 每個班級在學生會裡都有相同的代表席次。

examples.en: The painting is a representation of a quiet village.
examples.zh: 這幅畫描繪的是一個寧靜的村莊。

examples.en: The map is a simple representation of the city.
examples.zh: 這張地圖是這座城市的簡單呈現。

examples.en: The restaurant has a good reputation for fresh seafood.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以新鮮海鮮聞名。

examples.en: He worked hard to protect his reputation.
examples.zh: 他努力維護自己的名聲。

examples.en: A bad reputation can be hard to change.
examples.zh: 壞名聲很難改變。

examples.en: Firefighters rescued the cat from the tree.
examples.zh: 消防員從樹上救出了那隻貓。

examples.en: A boat rescued the family from the flood.
examples.zh: 一艘船把那家人從洪水中救了出來。

examples.en: The team rescued the old building from being torn down.
examples.zh: 這個團隊讓那棟老建築免於被拆除。

examples.en: The rescue took more than three hours.
examples.zh: 這次救援花了三個多小時。

examples.en: A rescue team arrived at the mountain quickly.
examples.zh: 救援隊很快抵達山區。

examples.en: The dog came to her rescue when she fell into the river.
examples.zh: 她掉進河裡時，那隻狗前來救她。

examples.en: Scientists are doing research on the new medicine.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究這種新藥。

examples.en: Good research takes time and patience to produce reliable results.
examples.zh: 好的研究需要時間與耐心，才能產生可靠的結果。

examples.en: I did some research online before buying the laptop.
examples.zh: 買筆記型電腦前，我先上網做了一些調查。

examples.en: Students research the topic in the library.
examples.zh: 學生在圖書館查詢這個主題的資料。

examples.en: She is researching the history of her town.
examples.zh: 她正在研究家鄉的歷史。

examples.en: We researched several hotels before booking one.
examples.zh: 我們在訂房前先查了幾家飯店。

examples.en: The researcher spent years studying birds in the forest.
examples.zh: 這位研究員花了好幾年研究森林裡的鳥。

examples.en: Researchers at the university found a new way to save water.
examples.zh: 這所大學的研究人員找到了節約用水的新方法。

examples.en: She became a medical researcher after college.
examples.zh: 她大學畢業後成為醫學研究員。

examples.en: She resembles her mother more than she resembles her father.
examples.zh: 比起爸爸，她更像媽媽。

examples.en: The two houses resemble each other in many ways.
examples.zh: 這兩間房子在許多方面很相似。

examples.en: Your handwriting closely resembles mine, so the teacher got confused.
examples.zh: 你的字跡和我的非常相似，所以老師搞混了。

examples.en: I made a reservation for four people at seven o'clock.
examples.zh: 我訂了晚上七點四個人的位子。

examples.en: Do you have a reservation at the restaurant for tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚在那間餐廳有訂位嗎？

examples.en: She had some reservations about the new plan, so she asked questions.
examples.zh: 她對新計畫有些保留，所以提出了問題。

examples.en: He decided to resign after ten years at the company.
examples.zh: 在這家公司工作十年後，他決定辭職。

examples.en: The manager will resign at the end of this month.
examples.zh: 經理將在這個月底辭職。

examples.en: Several teachers resigned because of the heavy workload.
examples.zh: 幾位老師因為工作量太大而辭職。

examples.en: She handed in her resignation on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 她星期一早上遞交了辭呈。

examples.en: The manager's resignation surprised everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 經理的辭職讓辦公室裡的每個人都很驚訝。

examples.en: He accepted the bad news with quiet resignation.
examples.zh: 他帶著無奈默默接受了這個壞消息。

examples.en: There was strong resistance to the new school rule.
examples.zh: 大家對新的校規非常抗拒。

examples.en: Wind resistance makes it harder to ride a bike uphill.
examples.zh: 風的阻力讓騎腳踏車上坡更費力。

examples.en: Enough sleep helps your body build resistance to illness.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠能幫助身體增強對疾病的抵抗力。

examples.en: Her New Year's resolution is to read one book a week.
examples.zh: 她的新年決心是每週讀一本書。

examples.en: The club passed a resolution to hold a bake sale.
examples.zh: 社團通過了舉辦烘焙義賣的決議。

examples.en: We hope for a quick resolution of the problem.
examples.zh: 我們希望這個問題能快速解決。

examples.en: The two friends talked and resolved the problem.
examples.zh: 兩位朋友談過之後，把問題解決了。

examples.en: She resolved to exercise every morning before school.
examples.zh: 她下定決心每天早上上學前運動。

examples.en: The teacher helped us resolve the argument about the game.
examples.zh: 老師幫我們解決了關於比賽的爭執。

examples.en: Workers restored the old temple to its original look.
examples.zh: 工人們把古老的廟宇修復成原本的樣貌。

examples.en: The power was restored after two hours.
examples.zh: 兩小時後電力恢復了。

examples.en: A good night's sleep will restore your energy.
examples.zh: 一夜好眠能讓你恢復精力。

examples.en: There is a height restriction for this ride.
examples.zh: 這項遊樂設施有身高限制。

examples.en: The city placed new restrictions on parking downtown.
examples.zh: 市政府對市中心的停車訂了新的限制。

examples.en: Travel restrictions were lifted last week after the storm passed.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，旅遊限制在上週解除了。

examples.en: The old building retains its original charm.
examples.zh: 這棟老建築保留了原本的魅力。

examples.en: She retained her title as the school champion.
examples.zh: 她保住了校內冠軍的頭銜。

examples.en: Some students retain information better by drawing it.
examples.zh: 有些學生透過畫圖能把資訊記得更牢。

examples.en: My grandfather retired at the age of sixty-five.
examples.zh: 我爺爺六十五歲退休。

examples.en: Mr. Lin plans to retire next spring.
examples.zh: 林先生打算明年春天退休。

examples.en: After she retired, she began to travel around the world.
examples.zh: 退休之後，她開始環遊世界。

examples.en: The little boy retreated behind his mother when he saw the dog.
examples.zh: 小男孩看到那隻狗，就退到媽媽身後。

examples.en: The team retreated to the locker room to rest.
examples.zh: 球隊退回休息室休息。

examples.en: When the rain got heavier, we retreated into a cafe.
examples.zh: 雨變大時，我們退進了一間咖啡店。

examples.en: The soldiers began their retreat after receiving orders from their commander.
examples.zh: 士兵接到指揮官的命令後，開始撤退。

examples.en: The company organized a two-day retreat for new employees.
examples.zh: 公司為新進員工舉辦了為期兩天的研習營。

examples.en: Her small garden is a peaceful retreat from city noise.
examples.zh: 她的小花園是遠離城市噪音的寧靜休憩處。

examples.en: He wanted revenge after losing the game last year.
examples.zh: 他想為去年輸掉比賽報一箭之仇。

examples.en: She did not seek revenge when her friend told a lie.
examples.zh: 朋友說謊時，她並沒有想要報復。

examples.en: The team won the rematch as sweet revenge for last year's loss.
examples.zh: 球隊在再次交手時獲勝，漂亮地報了去年落敗之仇。

examples.en: The editor asked for a revision of the first chapter.
examples.zh: 編輯要求修改第一章。

examples.en: I did a quick revision of my notes before the test.
examples.zh: 考試前我快速複習了一遍筆記。

examples.en: The new revision of the software fixes several errors.
examples.zh: 這套軟體的新修訂版修正了幾個錯誤。

examples.en: The Industrial Revolution changed how people worked.
examples.zh: 工業革命改變了人們的工作方式。

examples.en: The internet started a revolution in the way we shop.
examples.zh: 網路掀起了我們購物方式的一場變革。

examples.en: The wheel makes one revolution every two seconds.
examples.zh: 這個輪子每兩秒轉一圈。

senses.zh: 革命性的；革命的；劃時代的

examples.en: The company introduced a revolutionary new phone last week.
examples.zh: 公司上週推出了一款革命性的新手機。

examples.en: Her revolutionary idea changed the way we recycle at school.
examples.zh: 她劃時代的想法改變了我們在學校回收的方式。

examples.en: Students read about revolutionary leaders in history class.
examples.zh: 學生們在歷史課上讀到革命領袖的事蹟。

examples.en: The dog got a treat as a reward for good behavior.
examples.zh: 小狗因為表現乖巧而得到零食作為獎賞。

examples.en: There is a reward for anyone who finds the lost cat.
examples.zh: 找到走失的貓的人會有酬謝。

examples.en: Good grades are the reward for hard work.
examples.zh: 好成績是努力的回報。

examples.en: The school rewards students who read many books.
examples.zh: 學校獎勵閱讀大量書籍的學生。

examples.en: The boss rewarded the team with a day off.
examples.zh: 老闆用一天假期獎勵這個團隊。

examples.en: She rewarded the kind stranger with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 她用溫暖的微笑酬謝那位好心的陌生人。

examples.en: Moon and soon make a good rhyme in this poem.
examples.zh: 在這首詩裡，moon 和 soon 形成了很好的押韻效果。

examples.en: The children learned a funny nursery rhyme at school.
examples.zh: 孩子們在學校學了一首有趣的童謠。

examples.en: Every line of the poem ends with a rhyme.
examples.zh: 這首詩每一行的結尾都有韻腳。

examples.en: The word cat rhymes with hat, bat and mat.
examples.zh: cat 這個字和 hat、bat、mat 押韻。

examples.en: Can you think of a word that rhymes with blue?
examples.zh: 你能想到一個和 blue 押韻的字嗎？

examples.en: Not all song lyrics have to rhyme to sound nice.
examples.zh: 不是所有歌詞都要押韻才好聽。

examples.en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the song.
examples.zh: 鼓手在整首歌中維持穩定的節奏。

examples.en: The dancers moved to the rhythm of the music.
examples.zh: 舞者隨著音樂的節奏舞動。

examples.en: It took me a week to get used to the rhythm of my new job.
examples.zh: 我花了一週才習慣新工作的節奏。

examples.en: Can you solve this riddle before the bell rings?
examples.zh: 你能在鈴響之前解開這個謎語嗎？

examples.en: The teacher told us a funny riddle about a clock.
examples.zh: 老師告訴我們一個關於時鐘的有趣謎語。

examples.en: Nobody in the class could answer the riddle on the card.
examples.zh: 班上沒有人答得出卡片上的謎題。

examples.en: The police caught the robber near the train station.
examples.zh: 警方在火車站附近抓到了搶匪。

examples.en: The children dressed up as a robber and a police officer for the school play.
examples.zh: 孩子們在學校的戲劇裡扮成強盜和警察。

examples.en: In the fairy tale, the robber turned out to be a kind man.
examples.zh: 在這個童話故事裡，那位強盜其實是個好心人。

senses.zh: 愛情片；浪漫氣氛；愛情小說

examples.en: The movie is a sweet romance set in Paris.
examples.zh: 這部電影是以巴黎為背景的甜蜜愛情片。

examples.en: Candles and soft music added romance to the evening.
examples.zh: 蠟燭和輕柔的音樂為夜晚增添了浪漫氣氛。

examples.en: My sister loves reading romance on the train.
examples.zh: 我姊姊喜歡在火車上看愛情小說。

examples.en: Which route do you take to school every morning?
examples.zh: 你每天早上走哪一條路線去上學？

examples.en: The bus route passes the library and the park.
examples.zh: 這條公車路線會經過圖書館和公園。

examples.en: We chose the scenic route to enjoy the view.
examples.zh: 我們選了風景優美的路線來欣賞景色。

examples.en: She grew up in a rural area far from the city.
examples.zh: 她在遠離城市的鄉村地區長大。

examples.en: Rural schools often have fewer students than city schools.
examples.zh: 鄉村學校的學生人數通常比城市的學校少。

examples.en: Many young people leave rural towns to find jobs.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人離開鄉下小鎮去找工作。

examples.en: The old bike was rusty from years of standing in the rain.
examples.zh: 這輛舊腳踏車因為多年淋雨而生鏽了。

examples.en: Put some oil on the rusty hinge to stop it from squeaking.
examples.zh: 在生鏽的鉸鏈上滴點油，它就不會嘎吱響了。

examples.en: My French is rusty because I rarely speak it.
examples.zh: 我的法文很生疏，因為我很少說。

examples.en: Parents often make sacrifices for their children.
examples.zh: 父母常常為了孩子做出犧牲。

examples.en: Giving up sleep was a big sacrifice for the exam.
examples.zh: 為了考試而放棄睡眠是很大的犧牲。

examples.en: Moving to a smaller house was a sacrifice, but the family stayed happy.
examples.zh: 搬到較小的房子是一種割捨，但全家人依然很快樂。

examples.en: She sacrificed her weekends to help at the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 她犧牲週末去動物收容所幫忙。

examples.en: Don't sacrifice your health for a higher score.
examples.zh: 不要為了更高的分數而犧牲健康。

examples.en: He sacrificed his free time to finish the project.
examples.zh: 他犧牲空閒時間來完成專案。

examples.en: The satellite sends weather pictures back to Earth.
examples.zh: 這顆衛星把氣象圖像傳回地球。

examples.en: The moon is a natural satellite of the Earth.
examples.zh: 月球是地球的天然衛星。

examples.en: Our television gets its signal from a satellite.
examples.zh: 我們家的電視是從衛星取得訊號。

examples.en: She felt great satisfaction after finishing the marathon.
examples.zh: 完成馬拉松之後，她感到非常滿足。

examples.en: Customer satisfaction is our top priority at every stage of service.
examples.zh: 在服務的每個階段，顧客滿意度都是我們的首要考量。

examples.en: He smiled with satisfaction when he saw his test score.
examples.zh: 他看到考試成績時，滿意地笑了。

examples.en: There was scarcely any food left in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡幾乎沒剩食物。

examples.en: I could scarcely hear the teacher from the back row.
examples.zh: 我坐在最後一排，幾乎聽不到老師說話。

examples.en: She had scarcely sat down when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 她才剛坐下，電話就響了。

examples.en: The teacher scolded the boy for being late again.
examples.zh: 老師因為男孩又遲到而責罵他。

examples.en: Mom scolded me for leaving my shoes in the hall.
examples.zh: 媽媽責罵我把鞋子丟在走廊。

examples.en: Please don't scold the puppy, because it didn't know better.
examples.zh: 請不要責罵小狗，牠不懂事。

examples.en: I'd like two scoops of chocolate ice cream, please.
examples.zh: 請給我兩球巧克力冰淇淋。

examples.en: Add one scoop of flour to the bowl and stir.
examples.zh: 在碗裡加入一勺麵粉並攪拌。

examples.en: Use the scoop to measure the coffee beans.
examples.zh: 用勺子來量咖啡豆。

examples.en: He scooped some soup into my bowl.
examples.zh: 他舀了一些湯到我的碗裡。

examples.en: The boy scooped sand into a small bucket.
examples.zh: 男孩把沙子舀進一個小水桶裡。

examples.en: Scoop the seeds out of the pumpkin with a spoon.
examples.zh: 用湯匙把南瓜籽挖出來。

examples.en: He scratched his head and thought about the question.
examples.zh: 他抓抓頭，思考著這個問題。

examples.en: Don't let the cat scratch the new sofa.
examples.zh: 別讓貓把新沙發抓壞了。

examples.en: The key scratched the surface of the table.
examples.zh: 鑰匙刮傷了桌子的表面。

examples.en: There is a long scratch on the car door.
examples.zh: 車門上有一道長長的刮痕。

examples.en: The little girl had a small scratch on her knee.
examples.zh: 小女孩的膝蓋上有一道小擦傷。

examples.en: Wash the scratch with clean water before you put on a bandage.
examples.zh: 貼上繃帶之前，先用乾淨的水清洗那道抓痕。

examples.en: The museum has a famous sculpture of a horse.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有一座著名的馬的雕像。

examples.en: Her sculpture was made from recycled metal.
examples.zh: 她的雕塑作品是用回收金屬做成的。

examples.en: The students admired the sculpture in the school garden.
examples.zh: 學生們欣賞校園花園裡的雕像。

senses.zh: 安全的；穩固的；有安全感的

examples.en: Keep your passwords in a secure place.
examples.zh: 把你的密碼放在安全的地方。

examples.en: Make sure the ladder is secure before you climb it.
examples.zh: 爬梯子之前，要確認梯子很穩固。

examples.en: A stable job makes her feel secure about the future.
examples.zh: 穩定的工作讓她對未來有安全感。

examples.en: We secured the boxes with strong tape.
examples.zh: 我們用強力膠帶把箱子固定好。

examples.en: The team worked hard to secure a place in the final.
examples.zh: 球隊努力取得決賽的席位。

examples.en: The guide secured our tickets before the museum opened.
examples.zh: 導遊在博物館開放前就幫我們取得了門票。

examples.en: She seized the rope and pulled herself up.
examples.zh: 她抓住繩子，把自己拉了上去。

examples.en: You should seize the chance to study abroad.
examples.zh: 你應該把握出國讀書的機會。

examples.en: The customs officers seized the illegal goods at the airport.
examples.zh: 海關人員在機場查扣了違禁品。

examples.en: The first settlers built small houses near the river.
examples.zh: 最早的移居者在河邊蓋了小房子。

examples.en: Many settlers traveled west to find farmland.
examples.zh: 許多拓荒者往西遷徙，尋找農地。
