examples.en: A museum in town tells the story of the early settlers.
examples.zh: 鎮上的博物館講述了早期移民的故事。

examples.en: The storm caused severe damage to the village.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對村莊造成了嚴重的損害。

examples.en: She has a severe headache and needs to rest.
examples.zh: 她頭痛劇烈，需要休息。

examples.en: The coach was severe with players who came late.
examples.zh: 教練對遲到的球員很嚴厲。

examples.en: My grandmother taught me how to sew a button onto a shirt.
examples.zh: 奶奶教我怎麼把釦子縫到襯衫上。

examples.en: She sews all her own costumes for the school play.
examples.zh: 她學校戲劇的服裝全都是自己縫製的。

examples.en: Can you sew this torn sleeve before the party?
examples.zh: 你能在派對前把這隻破掉的袖子縫好嗎？

examples.en: We sat in the shade of a big tree.
examples.zh: 我們坐在大樹的樹蔭下。

examples.en: This shade of blue looks lovely on you.
examples.zh: 這種藍色的色調很適合你。

examples.en: The new lamp has a green shade.
examples.zh: 這盞新檯燈有個綠色的燈罩。

examples.en: We found a shady spot for our picnic.
examples.zh: 我們找到一處有樹蔭的地方野餐。

examples.en: The path through the park is cool and shady.
examples.zh: 穿過公園的小路涼爽又有樹蔭。

examples.en: Avoid shady websites that ask for your bank account number.
examples.zh: 避免使用要求你提供銀行帳號的可疑網站。

examples.en: It is shameful to cheat on an important exam.
examples.zh: 在重要的考試中作弊是可恥的。

examples.en: Throwing trash into the river is shameful behavior.
examples.zh: 把垃圾丟進河裡是可恥的行為。

examples.en: The player felt it was shameful to lose his temper in front of the kids.
examples.zh: 球員覺得在孩子們面前發脾氣很丟臉。

examples.en: My dad shaves every morning before he goes to work.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每天早上上班前都會刮鬍子。

examples.en: He shaved his head for the summer.
examples.zh: 他為了夏天剃了光頭。

examples.en: The barber shaved the old man carefully.
examples.zh: 理髮師仔細地幫老先生刮鬍子。

examples.en: We found shelter under a bridge when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 開始下雨時，我們在橋下找到了遮蔽處。

examples.en: The city built a new shelter for stray dogs.
examples.zh: 市政府蓋了一座新的流浪狗收容所。

examples.en: The tent gave us little shelter from the wind.
examples.zh: 帳篷幾乎無法替我們擋風。

examples.en: We sheltered in a cafe until the rain stopped.
examples.zh: 我們在咖啡店躲雨，直到雨停。

examples.en: The big tree sheltered the benches from the sun.
examples.zh: 大樹為長椅遮擋了陽光。

examples.en: Parents try to shelter young children from bad news.
examples.zh: 父母會設法保護年幼的孩子，不讓他們接觸壞消息。

examples.en: She works the night shift at the hospital.
examples.zh: 她在醫院值夜班。

examples.en: There has been a shift in public opinion on recycling.
examples.zh: 大眾對回收的看法已經有了轉變。

examples.en: My shift starts at nine and ends at five.
examples.zh: 我的班從九點開始，到五點結束。

examples.en: Please shift your bag so I can sit down.
examples.zh: 請把你的包包移一下，我才能坐下。

examples.en: The wind shifted and the clouds moved away.
examples.zh: 風向轉變，雲也飄走了。

examples.en: He shifted his weight from one foot to the other.
examples.zh: 他把重心從一隻腳換到另一隻腳。

examples.en: We went sightseeing in Taipei during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期時，我們到台北觀光。

examples.en: Sightseeing buses stop at all the famous places in the city.
examples.zh: 觀光公車會停靠城裡所有的知名景點。

examples.en: After lunch we spent the afternoon sightseeing by bike.
examples.zh: 午餐後，我們花了一個下午騎腳踏車遊覽。

examples.en: Please put your signature at the bottom of the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格底部簽名。

examples.en: The letter had no signature, so nobody knew who sent it.
examples.zh: 這封信沒有署名，所以沒人知道是誰寄的。

examples.en: Her signature is easy to recognize because of its big loops.
examples.zh: 她的簽名很好認，因為有很大的圈圈。

examples.en: The teacher explained the significance of the festival to the class.
examples.zh: 老師向全班說明這個節日的意義。

examples.en: The discovery is of great significance to science.
examples.zh: 這項發現對科學有重大的意義。

examples.en: Do not underestimate the significance of a good breakfast.
examples.zh: 別低估一頓好早餐的重要性。

examples.en: Child is singular, and children is plural.
examples.zh: child 是單數，children 是複數。

examples.en: Use a singular verb when everyone is the subject of a sentence.
examples.zh: everyone 作為句子的主詞時，要用單數動詞。

examples.en: Her singular talent for painting surprised the whole class.
examples.zh: 她非凡的繪畫天分讓全班都很驚訝。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to change each plural word into the singular.
examples.zh: 老師要我們把每個複數的字改成單數。

examples.en: Some nouns, like sheep, use the same word for the singular and the plural.
examples.zh: 有些名詞，例如 sheep，單數和複數用同一個字。

examples.en: Is data used as a singular or a plural in your textbook?
examples.zh: 在你的課本裡，data 是當單數還是複數使用？

examples.en: This is the site where the new library will be built.
examples.zh: 這裡是新圖書館的預定建造地點。

examples.en: You can buy tickets on the official site of the museum.
examples.zh: 你可以在博物館的官方網站購票。

examples.en: Workers must wear helmets at the building site.
examples.zh: 工人在建築工地必須戴安全帽。

examples.en: She made a quick sketch of the old temple.
examples.zh: 她快速畫了一張古老廟宇的素描。

examples.en: The architect showed us a sketch of the new house.
examples.zh: 建築師給我們看了新房子的草圖。

examples.en: I drew a sketch of my dog in art class.
examples.zh: 我在美術課上畫了一張我家狗的速寫。

examples.en: He sketched the mountains from his window.
examples.zh: 他從窗邊把群山畫成速寫。

examples.en: She sketched a map to show us the way.
examples.zh: 她畫了一張草圖，為我們指路。

examples.en: The students sketched flowers in the school garden.
examples.zh: 學生們在校園花園裡畫花朵的速寫。

examples.en: The tallest skyscraper in the city has more than a hundred floors.
examples.zh: 這座城市最高的摩天大樓有一百多層樓。

examples.en: From the top of the skyscraper, we could see the whole harbor.
examples.zh: 從摩天大樓的頂樓，我們可以看到整個港口。

examples.en: My uncle works in an office on the fortieth floor of a skyscraper.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一棟摩天大樓的四十樓辦公。

examples.en: There is a slight chance of rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午下雨的機率很低。

examples.en: I felt a slight pain in my left foot after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後我覺得左腳有一點痛。

examples.en: She is a slight girl, but she runs very fast.
examples.zh: 她是個身形纖細的女孩，但跑得很快。

examples.en: The company's new slogan is easy to remember.
examples.zh: 公司的新標語很容易記住。

examples.en: Students made posters with a slogan about saving water.
examples.zh: 學生們製作了印有節約用水標語的海報。

examples.en: Our team chose a short slogan for the school sports day.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍為學校運動會選了一句簡短的口號。

examples.en: There is only one socket in my room, so I need a power strip.
examples.zh: 我的房間只有一個插座，所以需要一條延長線。

examples.en: Please plug the lamp into the socket near the window.
examples.zh: 請把檯燈插進窗邊的插座。

examples.en: The doctor checked whether the bone had moved out of the shoulder socket.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查骨頭是否脫離了肩膀的關節窩。

examples.en: You need to update the software before you can use this app.
examples.zh: 你得先更新軟體才能使用這個應用程式。

examples.en: My brother works for a company that makes educational software.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在一家製作教育軟體的公司工作。

examples.en: The new software saves us a lot of time at the office.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體替我們在辦公室省下不少時間。

examples.en: Our school installed solar panels on the roof last year.
examples.zh: 我們學校去年在屋頂安裝了太陽能板。

examples.en: The solar system has eight planets that orbit the sun.
examples.zh: 太陽系有八顆繞太陽運行的行星。

examples.en: A solar eclipse happens when the moon passes in front of the sun.
examples.zh: 日蝕發生在月亮移到太陽前面的時候。

examples.en: He dug a hole in the garden with a spade.
examples.zh: 他用鏟子在花園裡挖了一個洞。

examples.en: The children brought a bucket and a spade to the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們帶了一個水桶和一把鏟子去海邊。

examples.en: I played the ace of spades and won the card game.
examples.zh: 我打出黑桃 A，贏了這場牌局。

examples.en: Do you have a spare pen I can borrow?
examples.zh: 你有多的筆可以借我嗎？

examples.en: We keep a spare key under the flowerpot.
examples.zh: 我們把備用鑰匙放在花盆底下。

examples.en: I read novels in my spare time.
examples.zh: 我在空閒時間看小說。

examples.en: Can you spare a few minutes to talk with me?
examples.zh: 你能抽出幾分鐘跟我談談嗎？

examples.en: The teacher spared us extra homework before the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期前老師免了我們額外的作業。

examples.en: Please spare me the details; I only want the result.
examples.zh: 細節就省了吧，我只想知道結果。

examples.en: A spark from the fireplace landed on the carpet.
examples.zh: 壁爐的一點火星掉到了地毯上。

examples.en: The teacher's story was the spark that made me love reading.
examples.zh: 老師的故事點燃了我對閱讀的熱愛。

examples.en: There was no spark between the two actors on the stage.
examples.zh: 這兩位演員在舞台上沒有火花。

examples.en: The speech sparked a lively discussion in class.
examples.zh: 這場演講在班上引發了熱烈的討論。

examples.en: A loose wire can spark and cause trouble.
examples.zh: 鬆脫的電線可能冒出火花而造成危險。

examples.en: The museum visit sparked her interest in history.
examples.zh: 參觀博物館激起了她對歷史的興趣。

examples.en: The museum has an old spear from more than two thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 博物館有一支兩千多年前的古老長矛。

examples.en: In the story, the hero carries a spear and a shield.
examples.zh: 故事中，英雄帶著一支長矛和一面盾牌。

examples.en: Students learned how people made a spear from stone and wood.
examples.zh: 學生們學到了古人如何用石頭和木頭製作長矛。

examples.en: This rare species of bird lives only on the island.
examples.zh: 這種稀有的鳥類只棲息在這座島上。

examples.en: Many species of fish are disappearing from the ocean.
examples.zh: 許多魚類物種正從海洋中消失。

examples.en: Scientists discover a new species of frog almost every year.
examples.zh: 科學家幾乎每年都會發現一種新的青蛙物種。

senses.zh: 精神上的；心靈的；宗教的

examples.en: Many people find spiritual peace in quiet places.
examples.zh: 許多人在安靜的地方找到心靈的平靜。

examples.en: Reading good books is a kind of spiritual food.
examples.zh: 讀好書是一種精神糧食。

examples.en: My grandmother is a spiritual person who visits the temple every week.
examples.zh: 我奶奶是個重視心靈生活的人，每週都去寺廟。

examples.en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from our hotel.
examples.zh: 我們從飯店望出去，山景十分壯麗。

examples.en: That's a splendid idea; let's try it this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個主意太棒了，我們這個週末試試看。

examples.en: The queen wore a splendid gold dress at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 女王在典禮上穿著華麗的金色禮服。

examples.en: Let's split the pizza into eight pieces.
examples.zh: 我們把披薩切成八片吧。

examples.en: The friends split the bill after dinner.
examples.zh: 朋友們飯後分攤了帳單。

examples.en: The old wooden table split in two when we moved it.
examples.zh: 那張舊木桌在我們搬動時裂成了兩半。

examples.en: There is a long split in the wall of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室的牆上有一道長長的裂縫。

examples.en: The class had a split over where to go on the trip.
examples.zh: 班上對旅行要去哪裡意見分歧。

examples.en: The two brothers agreed on a fifty-fifty split of the money.
examples.zh: 兄弟倆同意把錢對半分。

examples.en: Sprinkle some cheese on the pasta before serving.
examples.zh: 上菜前在義大利麵上撒一些起司。

examples.en: She sprinkled water on the plants every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都在植物上灑水。

examples.en: Dad sprinkled salt on the eggs and started eating.
examples.zh: 爸爸在蛋上撒了鹽，然後開始吃。

examples.en: He stabbed a fork into the potato to see if it was ready.
examples.zh: 他用叉子戳進馬鈴薯，看看熟了沒有。

examples.en: She stabbed a straw through the lid of her cup.
examples.zh: 她把吸管戳穿杯蓋。

examples.en: Do not stab the pencil into the desk.
examples.zh: 不要把鉛筆戳進桌子裡。

examples.en: You can check the status of your order on our website.
examples.zh: 你可以在我們的網站上查詢訂單的狀態。

examples.en: Her status as a student gives her a discount on tickets.
examples.zh: 她的學生身分讓她買票有折扣。

examples.en: In some jobs, social status is more important than salary.
examples.zh: 在某些工作中，社會地位比薪水更重要。

examples.en: Cut the stem of the rose at an angle.
examples.zh: 把玫瑰的莖斜切。

examples.en: The plant has a thin green stem and large leaves.
examples.zh: 這株植物有細細的綠色莖和大片的葉子。

examples.en: The stem of the word happiness is happy.
examples.zh: happiness 這個字的詞幹是 happy。

examples.en: Her fear of dogs stems from an accident in her childhood.
examples.zh: 她怕狗是源自童年的一次意外。

examples.en: Many of our problems stem from poor communication.
examples.zh: 我們的許多問題都源自溝通不良。

examples.en: The workers used towels to stem the flow of water from the pipe.
examples.zh: 工人們用毛巾阻止水從水管流出。

examples.en: My brother turned up the stereo while he cleaned his room.
examples.zh: 我哥哥打掃房間時把音響開得很大聲。

examples.en: We bought a new stereo for the living room.
examples.zh: 我們為客廳買了一組新音響。

examples.en: The car has a good stereo, so the long trip was fun.
examples.zh: 這輛車的音響很好，所以長途旅行很有趣。

examples.en: She wore black stockings with her school uniform.
examples.zh: 她穿制服時搭配黑色長襪。

examples.en: Children hang a stocking by the fireplace on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 孩子們在聖誕夜把長襪掛在壁爐旁。

examples.en: These warm stockings are perfect for cold winter days.
examples.zh: 這些保暖的長襪很適合寒冷的冬天。

examples.en: Swimming can strengthen your arms and legs.
examples.zh: 游泳可以強健你的手臂和雙腿。

examples.en: The two countries want to strengthen their trade relationship.
examples.zh: 這兩個國家想要加強彼此的貿易關係。

examples.en: Regular practice will strengthen your English skills.
examples.zh: 規律的練習會增進你的英文能力。

examples.en: We strive to give every customer the best service.
examples.zh: 我們努力為每位顧客提供最好的服務。

examples.en: She strives for perfect grades in every subject.
examples.zh: 她努力讓每一科都拿到完美的成績。

examples.en: Students should strive to do their best on the exam.
examples.zh: 學生應該在考試中努力發揮最佳表現。

examples.en: My grandfather had a stroke last year, but he is doing better now.
examples.zh: 我爺爺去年中風，不過他現在好多了。

examples.en: Students practice the strokes needed to write Chinese characters correctly.
examples.zh: 學生練習正確書寫中文字所需的筆畫。

examples.en: Butterfly is the hardest swimming stroke for me.
examples.zh: 蝶式是我覺得最難的泳式。

examples.en: She stroked the cat gently, and it began to purr.
examples.zh: 她輕輕撫摸那隻貓，牠就開始呼嚕呼嚕叫。

examples.en: The father stroked his daughter's hair until she fell asleep.
examples.zh: 爸爸輕撫女兒的頭髮，直到她睡著。

examples.en: He stroked his chin while he thought about the question.
examples.zh: 他一邊思考問題，一邊摸著下巴。

examples.en: The museum lets visitors walk through an old submarine.
examples.zh: 博物館讓遊客走進一艘舊潛水艇參觀。

examples.en: A submarine can stay under the sea for many weeks.
examples.zh: 潛水艇可以在水下待上好幾個星期。

examples.en: My little brother built a toy submarine for the science fair.
examples.zh: 我弟弟為科展做了一艘玩具潛水艇。

examples.en: Do you have any suggestions for our class trip?
examples.zh: 你對我們的班遊有什麼建議嗎？

examples.en: I took her suggestion and tried the soup.
examples.zh: 我接受了她的建議，試喝了那碗湯。

examples.en: Please put your suggestions in the box by the door.
examples.zh: 請把你的建議放進門邊的箱子裡。

examples.en: Please summarize the story in three sentences.
examples.zh: 請用三句話總結這個故事。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to summarize the main points of the article.
examples.zh: 老師要我們摘要這篇文章的重點。

examples.en: Let me summarize what we decided at today's meeting.
examples.zh: 讓我總結一下我們在今天會議中的決定。

examples.en: The surgeon spent three hours repairing the injured player's knee.
examples.zh: 外科醫生花了三個小時修復那位受傷球員的膝蓋。

examples.en: My aunt is a famous heart surgeon in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是台北一位有名的心臟外科醫生。

examples.en: The surgeon explained the plan to the patient before the operation.
examples.zh: 外科醫生在手術前向病人說明了計畫。

examples.en: He needs surgery on his knee next month.
examples.zh: 他下個月需要接受膝蓋手術。

examples.en: The surgery took four hours, but it went well.
examples.zh: 手術進行了四個小時，但很順利。

examples.en: She wants to study surgery at medical school.
examples.zh: 她想在醫學院學外科。

examples.en: Students must surrender their phones before entering the exam room.
examples.zh: 學生進入考場前必須交出手機。

examples.en: Don't surrender your dream just because the road is hard.
examples.zh: 不要因為路很難走就放棄夢想。

examples.en: The team refused to surrender and kept playing until the last minute.
examples.zh: 那支隊伍不肯放棄，一直比到最後一分鐘。

examples.en: The hotel has quiet and beautiful surroundings.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的四周環境安靜又優美。

examples.en: It takes time to get used to new surroundings.
examples.zh: 適應新環境需要時間。

examples.en: Our class went hiking to learn about the natural surroundings of the lake.
examples.zh: 我們班去健行，認識湖泊周遭的自然環境。

examples.en: The guard noticed a suspicious bag under the bench.
examples.zh: 警衛注意到長椅下有個可疑的包包。

examples.en: I became suspicious when the website asked for my password.
examples.zh: 那個網站要我輸入密碼時，我起了疑心。

examples.en: Her teacher was suspicious about why the homework looked so similar.
examples.zh: 老師對這些作業為何如此相似感到懷疑。

examples.en: The word banana has three syllables, with stress on the second.
examples.zh: banana 這個字有三個音節，重音落在第二個音節。

examples.en: The stress in this word falls on the second syllable.
examples.zh: 這個字的重音落在第二個音節。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to clap once for each syllable.
examples.zh: 老師要我們每個音節拍一次手。

senses.zh: 同情的；體諒的；表示支持的

examples.en: The nurse was kind and sympathetic to every patient.
examples.zh: 護理師對每位病人都親切又富有同情心。

examples.en: She gave me a sympathetic smile when I lost the game.
examples.zh: 我輸掉比賽時，她對我投以體諒的微笑。

examples.en: The manager was sympathetic to our request for more time.
examples.zh: 經理對我們提出的延長時間請求表示支持。

examples.en: We sent flowers to show our sympathy to the family.
examples.zh: 我們送花向那個家庭表達慰問之意。

examples.en: I have a lot of sympathy for people who work two jobs.
examples.zh: 我很同情那些同時做兩份工作的人。

examples.en: The students had little sympathy for the plan to cancel the party.
examples.zh: 學生們不太認同取消派對的計畫。

examples.en: She used a systematic method to study for the exam.
examples.zh: 她用有系統的方法準備考試。

examples.en: The team made a systematic check of every classroom.
examples.zh: 團隊對每間教室進行了有系統的檢查。

examples.en: A systematic approach helps us solve problems faster.
examples.zh: 有條理的做法能幫助我們更快解決問題。

examples.en: A technician came to fix the air conditioner this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一位技術人員來修冷氣。

examples.en: My cousin works as a lab technician at a hospital.
examples.zh: 我表哥在一家醫院擔任實驗室技術員。

examples.en: The sound technician checked the microphones before the concert.
examples.zh: 音響技師在演唱會前檢查了麥克風。

examples.en: Technological changes have made our lives more convenient.
examples.zh: 科技的進步讓我們的生活更方便。

examples.en: The school invested in new technological equipment for the classrooms.
examples.zh: 學校投資為教室添購了新的科技設備。

examples.en: Many people worry about the speed of technological development.
examples.zh: 許多人擔心科技發展的速度。

examples.en: We looked at the moon through a telescope.
examples.zh: 我們用望遠鏡觀察月亮。

examples.en: My father bought a telescope for my birthday.
examples.zh: 爸爸買了一支望遠鏡給我當生日禮物。

examples.en: The science club set up a telescope on the school roof.
examples.zh: 科學社在學校屋頂架設了一台望遠鏡。

examples.en: He has a tendency to talk too fast when he is nervous.
examples.zh: 他緊張時有說話太快的傾向。

examples.en: There is a tendency for prices to rise during the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期期間物價有上漲的趨勢。

examples.en: Some children have a tendency to be shy in new places.
examples.zh: 有些孩子到新的地方有害羞的傾向。

examples.en: The room became tense when the teacher announced the test.
examples.zh: 老師宣布考試時，教室裡的氣氛變得緊張。

examples.en: I felt tense before my first job interview.
examples.zh: 第一次面試前，我覺得很緊張。

examples.en: My neck muscles are tense after sitting at the computer all day.
examples.zh: 我整天坐在電腦前，頸部肌肉繃得很緊。

examples.en: The teacher explained the past tense with many examples.
examples.zh: 老師用許多例子說明過去式。

examples.en: In English, the verb changes with the tense.
examples.zh: 在英文裡，動詞會隨時態而變化。

examples.en: Which tense should I use in this sentence?
examples.zh: 這個句子我該用哪一種時態？

examples.en: There was a lot of tension in the room before the results came out.
examples.zh: 成績公布前，房間裡瀰漫著緊張的氣氛。

examples.en: Listening to music helps me release the tension after work.
examples.zh: 聽音樂幫助我在下班後釋放緊繃的情緒。

examples.en: Check the tension of the rope before you start climbing.
examples.zh: 開始攀爬前，先檢查繩子的拉緊程度。

examples.en: The little boy screamed in terror when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 燈熄滅時，小男孩嚇得尖叫。

examples.en: She felt a moment of terror when she lost her way in the dark.
examples.zh: 她在黑暗中迷路時，有一瞬間感到驚恐。

examples.en: The movie filled the children with terror, so they could not sleep.
examples.zh: 這部電影讓孩子們非常驚恐，所以他們睡不著。

examples.en: The theme of this year's school festival is friendship.
examples.zh: 今年校慶的主題是友誼。

examples.en: The main theme of the novel is courage.
examples.zh: 這本小說的主要主題是勇氣。

examples.en: We are planning a birthday party with an ocean theme.
examples.zh: 我們正在籌劃一場以海洋為主題的生日派對。

examples.en: The police made a thorough search of the building.
examples.zh: 警方對這棟大樓進行了徹底的搜查。

examples.en: She gave us a thorough explanation of the rules.
examples.zh: 她向我們詳細說明了規則。

examples.en: Please do a thorough check of your answers before you hand in the test.
examples.zh: 交卷前請仔細檢查你的答案。

examples.en: It was thoughtful of you to bring me an umbrella.
examples.zh: 你帶傘給我，真是體貼。

examples.en: He is a thoughtful boy who always helps his classmates.
examples.zh: 他是個體貼的男孩，總是幫助同學。

examples.en: She gave a thoughtful answer after thinking for a minute.
examples.zh: 她想了一分鐘後，給了一個深思熟慮的回答。

examples.en: My sister tickled my feet until I laughed.
examples.zh: 我姊姊搔我的腳底，搔到我大笑。

examples.en: The feather tickled my nose and made me sneeze.
examples.zh: 羽毛弄得我鼻子發癢，害我打噴嚏。

examples.en: The soft wool sweater tickles my neck.
examples.zh: 這件柔軟的羊毛衣讓我的脖子發癢。

examples.en: Check the bus timetable before you leave home.
examples.zh: 出門前先看一下公車時刻表。

examples.en: Our class timetable has two English lessons on Monday.
examples.zh: 我們的課表週一有兩堂英文課。

examples.en: The train timetable changes during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 火車時刻表在暑假期間會有變動。

examples.en: The timid puppy hid under the sofa when guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人來的時候，那隻膽小的小狗躲到沙發底下。

examples.en: She is too timid to speak in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她太膽小，不敢在全班面前說話。

examples.en: A timid student may need more time to answer the question.
examples.zh: 害羞的學生可能需要更多時間回答問題。

examples.en: The weather was hot but tolerable in the shade.
examples.zh: 天氣很熱，但待在陰涼處就還能忍受。

examples.en: The hotel was not great, but the price was tolerable.
examples.zh: 這間飯店不算太好，但價格還算可以接受。

examples.en: After taking some medicine, the pain became tolerable.
examples.zh: 吃了藥之後，疼痛變得可以忍受了。

examples.en: Our teacher teaches us tolerance toward different opinions.
examples.zh: 我們的老師教我們寬容看待不同的意見。

examples.en: The school has zero tolerance for cheating on exams.
examples.zh: 學校對考試作弊零容忍。

examples.en: Some people have a high tolerance for spicy food.
examples.zh: 有些人對辛辣食物的耐受度很高。

senses.zh: 寬容的；能容忍的；耐受的

examples.en: Our teacher is tolerant of mistakes when students are trying their best.
examples.zh: 學生盡力時，我們的老師對錯誤很寬容。

examples.en: People in this neighborhood are tolerant of different customs.
examples.zh: 這個社區的人對不同的習俗很包容。

examples.en: This plant is tolerant of both heat and dry soil.
examples.zh: 這種植物耐熱，也耐乾燥的土壤。

examples.en: The school will not tolerate cheating on exams.
examples.zh: 學校不會容許考試作弊。

examples.en: I can't tolerate the noise from the building site any longer.
examples.zh: 我再也無法忍受工地傳來的噪音了。

examples.en: Some people cannot tolerate spicy food very well.
examples.zh: 有些人不太能耐受辛辣的食物。

examples.en: We visited an ancient tomb during our trip to Egypt.
examples.zh: 我們到埃及旅行時參觀了一座古墓。

examples.en: The tomb was built more than two thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 這座墳墓是在兩千多年前建造的。

examples.en: Tourists were asked to be quiet inside the tomb.
examples.zh: 遊客被要求在墓室裡保持安靜。

examples.en: The tortoise moved slowly across the garden.
examples.zh: 那隻陸龜慢慢地爬過花園。

examples.en: A tortoise can live for more than a hundred years.
examples.zh: 陸龜可以活一百多年。

examples.en: My brother keeps a small tortoise as a pet.
examples.zh: 我弟弟養了一隻小陸龜當寵物。

examples.en: The flood was a great tragedy for the whole village.
examples.zh: 這場洪水對整個村莊來說是一大悲劇。

examples.en: We read a famous tragedy by Shakespeare in English class.
examples.zh: 我們在英文課讀了莎士比亞的一齣著名悲劇。

examples.en: It would be a tragedy if the old library were torn down.
examples.zh: 如果那間老圖書館被拆掉，那就太可惜了。

examples.en: The tragic news made everyone in the room fall silent.
examples.zh: 這則悲慘的消息讓房裡的每個人都沉默了。

examples.en: It was a tragic accident that could have been avoided.
examples.zh: 那是一場原本可以避免的不幸意外。

examples.en: The movie has a tragic ending, so bring some tissues.
examples.zh: 這部電影的結局很悲傷，所以要帶些衛生紙。

examples.en: I need to transfer some money to my mother's account.
examples.zh: 我需要轉一些錢到我媽媽的帳戶。

examples.en: You have to transfer to the red line at the next station.
examples.zh: 你必須在下一站轉乘紅線。

examples.en: My father was transferred to the Taichung office last month.
examples.zh: 我爸爸上個月被調到臺中辦公室。

examples.en: The bank transfer will take about two working days.
examples.zh: 銀行轉帳大約需要兩個工作天。

examples.en: She asked for a transfer to a different class.
examples.zh: 她申請轉到另一個班級。

examples.en: This ticket allows one free transfer within ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 這張票允許在九十分鐘內免費轉乘一次。

examples.en: Heat can transform liquid water into steam in a boiler.
examples.zh: 熱能可以使鍋爐中的液態水變成水蒸氣。

examples.en: The new park will transform this empty lot into a green space.
examples.zh: 新公園會把這塊空地變成綠地。

examples.en: Online learning has transformed the way students study.
examples.zh: 線上學習已經改變了學生的讀書方式。

examples.en: Can you translate this sentence into Chinese for me?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我把這個句子翻成中文嗎？

examples.en: She translated the menu for the foreign tourists.
examples.zh: 她為外國遊客翻譯了菜單。

examples.en: Good ideas do not always translate into good results.
examples.zh: 好點子不一定會轉化成好成果。

examples.en: The translation of this poem is very close to the original.
examples.zh: 這首詩的譯文非常貼近原文。

examples.en: I read the English translation of the novel first.
examples.zh: 我先讀了這本小說的英文譯本。

examples.en: Translation is harder than many people think.
examples.zh: 翻譯比許多人想的還要困難。

examples.en: The translator helped us talk with the Japanese guests.
examples.zh: 譯者協助我們與日本客人交談。

examples.en: My aunt works as a translator for a publishing company.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在出版社擔任譯者。

examples.en: I use a translator app when I travel abroad.
examples.zh: 我出國旅行時會用翻譯應用程式。

senses.zh: 交通運輸；運輸工具；交通

examples.en: Public transportation in Taipei is cheap and convenient.
examples.zh: 台北的大眾運輸既便宜又方便。

examples.en: The city provides free transportation for senior citizens.
examples.zh: 這座城市為長者提供免費的交通服務。

examples.en: What kind of transportation do you take to school?
examples.zh: 你搭什麼交通工具上學？

examples.en: Her hands trembled as she opened the letter.
examples.zh: 她打開信時，雙手不停地顫抖。

examples.en: The little dog trembled during the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 雷雨中，那隻小狗一直發抖。

examples.en: The windows trembled when the truck drove past.
examples.zh: 卡車駛過時，窗戶微微震動。

examples.en: The concert drew a tremendous crowd to the stadium.
examples.zh: 這場演唱會吸引了大批群眾到體育場。

examples.en: Thank you for your tremendous help with the project.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在這個專案上給予莫大的協助。

examples.en: There has been a tremendous change in our town.
examples.zh: 我們的小鎮出現了巨大的改變。

examples.en: The team's triumph in the final made the whole school proud.
examples.zh: 球隊在決賽中的勝利讓全校引以為傲。

examples.en: Finishing the marathon was a personal triumph for him.
examples.zh: 跑完馬拉松對他來說是個人的一大成就。

examples.en: The new bridge is a triumph of modern engineering.
examples.zh: 這座新橋是現代工程的一大成就。

examples.en: Our class triumphed over the other teams in the singing contest.
examples.zh: 我們班在歌唱比賽中擊敗了其他隊伍。

examples.en: She triumphed in the end after years of hard work.
examples.zh: 經過多年努力，她終於成功了。

examples.en: Good will always triumph over evil in this story.
examples.zh: 在這個故事裡，善良總是戰勝邪惡。

senses.zh: 麻煩的；令人煩惱的；棘手的

examples.en: This old computer is troublesome and keeps shutting down.
examples.zh: 這台舊電腦很麻煩，一直自動關機。

examples.en: The troublesome noise from upstairs kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 樓上惹人厭的噪音讓我整晚睡不著。

examples.en: He found the form troublesome to fill out.
examples.zh: 他覺得這份表格填起來很麻煩。

examples.en: The little boy tumbled down the grassy hill.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩從長滿草的山丘上滾了下來。

examples.en: Stock prices tumbled after the bad news came out.
examples.zh: 壞消息一公布，股價就暴跌了。

examples.en: Be careful, or you will tumble off the chair.
examples.zh: 小心點，不然你會從椅子上跌下來。

examples.en: She took a bad tumble on the icy sidewalk.
examples.zh: 她在結冰的人行道上重重摔了一跤。

examples.en: The company's shares took a sharp tumble this week.
examples.zh: 這家公司的股價本週大幅下跌。

examples.en: The toddler had a small tumble but was not hurt.
examples.zh: 那個學步的幼兒跌了一跤，但沒有受傷。

examples.en: A small bird sat on a thin twig outside the window.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥停在窗外的細枝上。

examples.en: We gathered dry twigs to start the campfire.
examples.zh: 我們撿了乾的細枝來生營火。

examples.en: The twig snapped when I stepped on it.
examples.zh: 我踩到那根細枝時，它啪地斷了。

senses.zh: 普遍的；全世界的；通用的

examples.en: Music is a universal language that everyone can enjoy.
examples.zh: 音樂是人人都能欣賞的世界共通語言。

examples.en: Smiling is a universal sign of friendliness.
examples.zh: 微笑是友善的普遍象徵。

examples.en: This charger has a universal plug that fits most countries.
examples.zh: 這個充電器有通用插頭，適用於大多數國家。

examples.en: The doctor urged him to get more rest.
examples.zh: 醫生力勸他多休息。

examples.en: Our teacher urges us to read at least one book a month.
examples.zh: 我們的老師敦促我們每個月至少讀一本書。

examples.en: The mayor urged everyone to save water during the dry season.
examples.zh: 市長呼籲大家在乾季時節約用水。

examples.en: I had a sudden urge to eat ice cream.
examples.zh: 我突然很想吃冰淇淋。

examples.en: She felt a strong urge to call her old friend.
examples.zh: 她強烈地想打電話給老朋友。

examples.en: He tried to resist the urge to check his phone.
examples.zh: 他努力克制想看手機的衝動。

examples.en: I have an urgent message for the manager.
examples.zh: 我有一則緊急訊息要給經理。

examples.en: The patient needs urgent medical care after the serious accident.
examples.zh: 這名病人在嚴重事故後需要緊急醫療照護。

examples.en: Please reply as soon as possible because the matter is urgent.
examples.zh: 這件事很急，請盡快回覆。

examples.en: This dictionary gives clear examples of word usage.
examples.zh: 這本字典對字詞用法提供了清楚的例子。

examples.en: The usage of electricity goes up during the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天的用電量會增加。

examples.en: Please read the instructions for proper usage before you start.
examples.zh: 開始前請先閱讀說明，了解正確的使用方式。

senses.zh: 徒勞的；自負的；愛慕虛榮的

examples.en: All our efforts to save the old tree were in vain.
examples.zh: 我們搶救那棵老樹的所有努力都白費了。

examples.en: He is so vain that he checks the mirror every few minutes.
examples.zh: 他很愛慕虛榮，每隔幾分鐘就照一次鏡子。

examples.en: She made a vain attempt to open the locked door.
examples.zh: 她徒勞地想打開那扇鎖住的門。

examples.en: A vast desert lies to the north of the city.
examples.zh: 城市北邊有一大片廣闊的沙漠。

examples.en: The library has a vast collection of books.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館有大量的藏書。

examples.en: Vast amounts of data are stored on this server.
examples.zh: 這台伺服器儲存了大量的資料。

examples.en: My cousin has been a vegetarian for five years.
examples.zh: 我表哥已經吃素五年了。

examples.en: The restaurant has a special menu for vegetarians.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳有為素食者設計的特別菜單。

examples.en: Are you a vegetarian, or do you eat fish?
examples.zh: 你是素食者，還是你也吃魚？

examples.en: We ordered a vegetarian pizza for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐點了一份素食披薩。

examples.en: This cafeteria offers a vegetarian meal every day.
examples.zh: 這間自助餐廳每天都提供素食餐。

examples.en: She follows a vegetarian diet for health reasons.
examples.zh: 她基於健康因素採取素食飲食。

examples.en: A large vessel entered the harbor early this morning.
examples.zh: 一艘大船今天一早駛進港口。

examples.en: Pour the soup into a large vessel and let it cool.
examples.zh: 把湯倒進大容器裡放涼。

examples.en: The doctor said a blood vessel in his eye had burst.
examples.zh: 醫生說他眼睛裡有一條血管破裂了。

examples.en: Drivers who violate traffic rules may have to pay a fine.
examples.zh: 違反交通規則的駕駛可能得繳罰款。

examples.en: It is rude to violate someone's privacy by reading their messages.
examples.zh: 偷看別人的訊息是侵犯隱私的失禮行為。

examples.en: The company violated the contract by delivering late.
examples.zh: 這家公司延遲交貨，違反了合約。

examples.en: Parking here is a violation of the city rules.
examples.zh: 在這裡停車違反市府規定。

examples.en: He received a ticket for a traffic violation.
examples.zh: 他因交通違規而收到罰單。

examples.en: Copying someone else's work is a violation of school policy.
examples.zh: 抄襲別人的作品違反校規。

examples.en: Honesty is a virtue that everyone should have.
examples.zh: 誠實是每個人都該具備的美德。

examples.en: Patience is a great virtue when you teach young children.
examples.zh: 教導幼童時，耐心是一項很重要的美德。

examples.en: There is no virtue in waiting until the last minute.
examples.zh: 拖到最後一刻才動手並沒有什麼好處。

examples.en: The flu virus spreads easily in crowded places.
examples.zh: 流感病毒在擁擠的地方很容易傳播。

examples.en: Wash your hands often to avoid catching a virus.
examples.zh: 常洗手，以免感染病毒。

examples.en: A virus infected my computer and deleted some files.
examples.zh: 電腦病毒感染了我的電腦，還刪除了一些檔案。

examples.en: Pictures are a helpful visual aid for young learners.
examples.zh: 圖片對年幼的學習者來說是很有幫助的視覺輔助。

examples.en: She is studying visual arts at a university in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 她在高雄的一所大學主修視覺藝術。

examples.en: The doctor tested the visual ability of every student.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了每位學生的視力。

senses.zh: 極重要的；必不可少的；生命的

examples.en: Water is vital for all living things.
examples.zh: 水對所有生物來說都是不可或缺的。

examples.en: Good communication is vital to a team's success.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通對團隊的成功至關重要。

examples.en: The nurse checked the patient's vital signs every hour.
examples.zh: 護理師每小時檢查一次病人的生命徵象。

examples.en: Joining the beach cleanup is voluntary, so nobody has to come.
examples.zh: 參加淨灘是自願的，所以沒有人一定要來。

examples.en: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter on weekends.
examples.zh: 她週末在動物收容所做志工。

examples.en: The company offers a voluntary health check for all employees.
examples.zh: 公司為所有員工提供自願參加的健康檢查。

examples.en: We need more volunteers to help at the school fair.
examples.zh: 我們需要更多志工來協助學校園遊會。

examples.en: The volunteers handed out free water to the runners.
examples.zh: 志工們發免費的水給跑者。

examples.en: My mother is a volunteer at the city library.
examples.zh: 我媽媽是市立圖書館的志工。

examples.en: Who wants to volunteer to clean the classroom?
examples.zh: 誰要自願打掃教室？

examples.en: She volunteered to carry the heavy boxes for her neighbor.
examples.zh: 她自願幫鄰居搬那些沉重的箱子。

examples.en: Tom volunteered his time to teach English at the center.
examples.zh: 湯姆自願花時間在中心教英文。

examples.en: The voyage from Keelung to Japan takes about two days.
examples.zh: 從基隆到日本的航程大約要兩天。

examples.en: They set out on a long voyage across the Pacific Ocean.
examples.zh: 他們展開了橫越太平洋的漫長航行。

examples.en: The captain wished everyone a safe voyage.
examples.zh: 船長祝大家一路平安。

examples.en: A loud noise wakened the baby in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 一陣巨響在半夜把嬰兒吵醒了。

examples.en: She gently wakened her grandfather from his nap.
examples.zh: 她輕輕地把爺爺從午睡中叫醒。

examples.en: I usually waken before the alarm clock rings.
examples.zh: 我通常在鬧鐘響起之前就醒了。

examples.en: You can find the school schedule on our website.
examples.zh: 你可以在我們的網站上找到學校的課表。

examples.en: The company is building a new website for online shopping.
examples.zh: 這家公司正在建立一個新的網路購物網站。

examples.en: Please visit the website to sign up for the free class.
examples.zh: 請上網站報名這堂免費課程。

examples.en: The government is working to improve the welfare of senior citizens.
examples.zh: 政府正努力改善年長者的福祉。

examples.en: Teachers care about the health and welfare of their students.
examples.zh: 老師很關心學生的健康與福祉。

examples.en: The company supports employee welfare by offering paid holidays.
examples.zh: 這家公司提供有薪假，以增進員工福祉。

examples.en: He winked at me to show that he was joking.
examples.zh: 他對我眨眼，表示他在開玩笑。

examples.en: The baby winked at her mother and giggled.
examples.zh: 寶寶對媽媽眨了眨眼，咯咯地笑。

examples.en: Stars winked in the clear night sky.
examples.zh: 星星在晴朗的夜空中閃爍。

examples.en: She gave me a wink across the table.
examples.zh: 她隔著桌子對我眨了眨眼。

examples.en: I didn't sleep a wink because of the loud music.
examples.zh: 音樂太吵了，我一點都沒睡著。

examples.en: With a quick wink, he left the room.
examples.zh: 他迅速眨了一下眼，就離開了房間。

examples.en: The comedian is famous for his quick wit.
examples.zh: 這位喜劇演員以機智敏捷聞名。

examples.en: She answered the difficult question with great wit.
examples.zh: 她十分機智地回答了那個難題。

examples.en: My grandfather's wit made everyone at the dinner table laugh.
examples.zh: 我爺爺的風趣讓餐桌上的每個人都笑了。

examples.en: The witch in the story lived in a small house in the forest.
examples.zh: 故事裡的女巫住在森林裡的一間小屋。

examples.en: Many children dress up as a witch on Halloween.
examples.zh: 許多孩子在萬聖節時會打扮成女巫。

examples.en: In the fairy tale, a kind witch helped the lost girl.
examples.zh: 在童話故事裡，一位善良的女巫幫助了迷路的女孩。

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash from the ATM.
examples.zh: 我需要從提款機領一些現金。

examples.en: She decided to withdraw from the speech contest.
examples.zh: 她決定退出演講比賽。

examples.en: The company withdrew its advertisement after many complaints.
examples.zh: 在收到許多客訴後，公司撤下了那則廣告。

examples.en: A witness saw the car hit the fence and called the police.
examples.zh: 一名目擊者看到汽車撞上圍籬，便報了警。

examples.en: The witness told the judge what happened that night.
examples.zh: 證人向法官說明了那晚發生的事。

examples.en: Two witnesses signed the wedding document at the end of the ceremony.
examples.zh: 儀式結束時，兩位見證人在結婚文件上簽了名。

examples.en: Many people witnessed the accident at the corner.
examples.zh: 許多人目睹了轉角的那場意外。

examples.en: We witnessed the first snowfall of the year.
examples.zh: 我們親眼見到了今年的第一場雪。

examples.en: This town has witnessed great changes in the last ten years.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮在過去十年見證了巨大的變化。

examples.en: I do a thirty-minute workout every morning before school.
examples.zh: 我每天早上上學前都做三十分鐘的運動。

examples.en: The coach planned a hard workout for the team.
examples.zh: 教練為球隊安排了一場高強度的訓練。

examples.en: After a long workout, he drank a bottle of water.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的運動後，他喝了一瓶水。

senses.zh: 殘骸；失事的船或車；身心俱疲的人

examples.en: The wreck of the old ship lies at the bottom of the sea.
examples.zh: 那艘老船的殘骸沉在海底。

examples.en: Divers explored the wreck near the island.
examples.zh: 潛水員探索了島嶼附近的沉船殘骸。

examples.en: After the long trip, I felt like a wreck.
examples.zh: 經過長途旅行後，我覺得自己累垮了。

examples.en: The heavy rain wrecked our picnic plans.
examples.zh: 大雨毀了我們的野餐計畫。

examples.en: A strong wind wrecked the small boat on the rocks.
examples.zh: 強風使那艘小船在岩石上失事。

examples.en: Don't let one bad grade wreck your confidence.
examples.zh: 別讓一次考不好就毀掉你的信心。

examples.en: The students yawned during the long speech.
examples.zh: 學生們在冗長的演講中打哈欠。

examples.en: My dog yawned and curled up on the sofa.
examples.zh: 我的狗打了個哈欠，然後蜷縮在沙發上。

examples.en: I tried not to yawn in front of the teacher.
examples.zh: 我努力不在老師面前打哈欠。

examples.en: She covered her mouth to hide a yawn.
examples.zh: 她摀住嘴巴掩飾一個哈欠。

examples.en: His big yawn showed that he was very tired.
examples.zh: 他打了個大哈欠，顯示他非常疲倦。

examples.en: A yawn spread quickly from one person to another in the room.
examples.zh: 哈欠在房間裡一個接一個地傳開了。

senses.zh: 年輕的；青春的；朝氣蓬勃的

examples.en: My grandmother has a youthful face and a warm smile.
examples.zh: 我奶奶有一張年輕的臉和溫暖的笑容。

examples.en: The team is full of youthful energy.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍充滿了青春活力。

examples.en: He still looks youthful even though he is almost sixty.
examples.zh: 雖然他快六十歲了，看起來仍然很年輕。

examples.en: The doctor helped the addict stop smoking.
examples.zh: 醫生協助那位上癮者戒菸。

examples.en: My brother is a game addict who plays until midnight.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是個遊戲迷，會玩到半夜。

examples.en: Some coffee addicts cannot start the day without a cup.
examples.zh: 有些咖啡成癮的人沒有喝上一杯就無法開始一天。

senses.zh: 含糊的；模稜兩可的；有歧義的

examples.en: The teacher said the question was ambiguous and rewrote it.
examples.zh: 老師說這個問題有歧義，便重新寫了一次。

examples.en: His answer was ambiguous, so I still did not know what he wanted.
examples.zh: 他的回答很含糊，所以我還是不知道他想要什麼。

examples.en: The sign is ambiguous and confuses many visitors.
examples.zh: 這個標示模稜兩可，讓許多訪客感到困惑。

examples.en: The museum displays arms and armor from several historical periods.
examples.zh: 博物館展示來自幾個歷史時期的武器與盔甲。

examples.en: The two countries signed an agreement to limit the sale of arms.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署協議，限制武器銷售。

examples.en: He sat in the chair and rested his arms on the table.
examples.zh: 他坐在椅子上，把手臂擱在桌上。

examples.en: This restaurant serves authentic Taiwanese beef noodles.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應道地的台灣牛肉麵。

examples.en: Please check that the signature on the painting is authentic.
examples.zh: 請確認這幅畫上的簽名是真的。

examples.en: She wanted an authentic experience, so she stayed with a local family.
examples.zh: 她想要真實的體驗，所以住在當地人家裡。

examples.en: The singer gave me her autograph after the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱會結束後，那位歌手給了我她的簽名。

examples.en: He keeps a baseball with the autograph of a famous player.
examples.zh: 他收藏一顆有知名球員簽名的棒球。

examples.en: Fans waited outside the hotel to ask for an autograph.
examples.zh: 粉絲在飯店外等著要簽名。

examples.en: Could you autograph this notebook for my little sister, please?
examples.zh: 你可以在這本筆記本上簽名送給我妹妹嗎？

examples.en: The author will autograph copies of her new book on Saturday.
examples.zh: 作者星期六會在她的新書上簽名。

examples.en: The players autographed the poster and handed it to the children.
examples.zh: 球員們在海報上簽了名，然後把它遞給孩子們。

examples.en: Be careful; the blade of this knife is very sharp.
examples.zh: 當心，這把刀的刀刃非常鋒利。

examples.en: He bought a new blade for his razor at the store.
examples.zh: 他在店裡買了一片新的刮鬍刀片。

examples.en: The blades of the fan spun faster when he turned the dial.
examples.zh: 他轉動旋鈕時，電風扇的葉片轉得更快了。

examples.en: A small apple has fewer calories than a slice of cake.
examples.zh: 一顆小蘋果的卡路里比一片蛋糕少。

examples.en: The label shows how many calories are in each bottle.
examples.zh: 標籤上標示每瓶含有多少卡路里。

examples.en: Dancing for an hour can burn a lot of calories.
examples.zh: 跳舞一小時可以消耗許多卡路里。

senses.zh: 運送業者；帶原者；航空公司

examples.en: The package was picked up by a delivery carrier this morning.
examples.zh: 包裹今天早上由運送業者取走了。

examples.en: Mosquitoes can be carriers of serious diseases.
examples.zh: 蚊子可能是嚴重疾病的帶原者。

examples.en: Our flight is operated by a low-cost carrier from Japan.
examples.zh: 我們的班機由一家日本的廉價航空公司營運。

examples.en: Books are sorted into categories such as fiction and science.
examples.zh: 書籍依小說和科學等類別分類。

examples.en: Which category does this product belong to?
examples.zh: 這項產品屬於哪一類？

examples.en: She won the prize in the best actress category.
examples.zh: 她在最佳女主角的類別中獲獎。

examples.en: Art class helps students develop their creativity.
examples.zh: 美術課幫助學生培養創造力。

examples.en: The ad won an award for its creativity and humor.
examples.zh: 這支廣告因創意與幽默而得獎。

examples.en: Working in a small team can encourage creativity and new ideas.
examples.zh: 在小團隊中工作可以激發創意與新點子。

examples.en: The fried chicken was crunchy on the outside and juicy inside.
examples.zh: 這份炸雞外皮酥脆，裡面多汁。

examples.en: I like to eat crunchy apples as an afternoon snack.
examples.zh: 我喜歡把爽脆的蘋果當下午點心。

examples.en: He poured cold milk over his bowl of crunchy cereal.
examples.zh: 他把冷牛奶倒在那碗酥脆的穀片上。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a cube made of paper.
examples.zh: 老師拿給我們看一個紙做的立方體。

examples.en: Cut the cheese into small cubes for the salad.
examples.zh: 把起司切成小方塊放進沙拉裡。

examples.en: The cube of three is twenty-seven, while its square is nine.
examples.zh: 三的立方是二十七，而它的平方是九。

examples.en: The manager gave a defensible reason for the delay.
examples.zh: 經理對延遲提出了站得住腳的理由。

examples.en: Is this opinion defensible with the facts we have?
examples.zh: 以我們手上的事實，這個看法可以辯護嗎？

examples.en: The old fort stood on a hill, which made it easily defensible.
examples.zh: 那座舊堡壘建在山丘上，因此很容易防守。

examples.en: We walked on the grass, which was wet with morning dew.
examples.zh: 我們走在被晨間露水沾濕的草地上。

examples.en: Drops of dew shone like tiny pearls on the spider web.
examples.zh: 露珠像小珍珠一樣在蜘蛛網上閃閃發亮。

examples.en: The dew dries quickly once the sun comes up.
examples.zh: 太陽一出來，露水很快就乾了。

examples.en: The teacher drew a diagram of the water cycle on the board.
examples.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了水循環的示意圖。

examples.en: The diagram in the manual shows where each screw goes.
examples.zh: 說明書裡的圖解顯示每顆螺絲該裝在哪裡。

examples.en: This diagram compares the sales of three products.
examples.zh: 這張圖表比較了三項產品的銷售量。

examples.en: The bus has a special seat for riders with a disability.
examples.zh: 公車上有給身心障礙乘客的專用座位。

examples.en: A learning disability does not stop her from enjoying school.
examples.zh: 學習障礙並不妨礙她享受校園生活。

examples.en: She started a club to raise awareness about disability.
examples.zh: 她成立了社團，提高大家對身心障礙的認識。

examples.en: Our school has a diverse group of students from many countries.
examples.zh: 我們學校的學生來自許多國家，組成很多元。

examples.en: The market sells a diverse range of fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 這個市場販售種類繁多的新鮮水果。

examples.en: The two sisters have very diverse interests.
examples.zh: 這對姊妹的興趣大不相同。

examples.en: The city is proud of its cultural diversity.
examples.zh: 這座城市以文化多元為傲。

examples.en: The rainforest is famous for its diversity of plants and animals.
examples.zh: 熱帶雨林以動植物的多樣性聞名。

examples.en: The company wants more diversity among its employees.
examples.zh: 這間公司希望員工組成更多元。

examples.en: The boy ran quickly to dodge the ball.
examples.zh: 男孩快速跑開以閃避那顆球。

examples.en: She tried to dodge the question about her grades.
examples.zh: 她試圖迴避關於成績的問題。

examples.en: Cyclists have to dodge cars on the busy street.
examples.zh: 騎腳踏車的人得在繁忙的街上閃避車輛。

senses.zh: 民族的；族群的；具民族特色的

examples.en: Taiwan has many ethnic groups, each with its own traditions.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多族群，各有各的傳統。

examples.en: We tried ethnic food from several countries at the festival.
examples.zh: 我們在慶典上嚐了好幾個國家的民族風味料理。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to respect everyone's ethnic background.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們尊重每個人的族群背景。

examples.en: The teacher gave each student a written evaluation.
examples.zh: 老師給每位學生一份書面評價。

examples.en: An evaluation of the new program will begin next month.
examples.zh: 新計畫的評估下個月開始。

examples.en: Employees receive a performance evaluation once a year.
examples.zh: 員工每年接受一次績效考核。

examples.en: Scientists found a fossil of a giant fish near the river.
examples.zh: 科學家在河邊發現了一條巨型魚的化石。

examples.en: The museum has a fossil that is millions of years old.
examples.zh: 博物館有一塊已有數百萬年歷史的化石。

examples.en: Students used a small brush to clean the fossil carefully.
examples.zh: 學生們用小刷子小心地清理化石。

examples.en: Please handle this box with care; the glasses inside are fragile.
examples.zh: 請小心搬這個箱子，裡面的玻璃杯很易碎。

examples.en: The fragile old bridge is closed to heavy trucks.
examples.zh: 這座脆弱的老橋禁止大型卡車通行。

examples.en: After the illness, her health was still fragile.
examples.zh: 生病之後，她的身體仍然很虛弱。

examples.en: He sighed with frustration when the computer froze again.
examples.zh: 電腦又當機時，他懊惱地嘆了口氣。

examples.en: Learning a new language can cause some frustration at first.
examples.zh: 學習新語言一開始可能會帶來一些挫折感。

examples.en: She tried to hide her frustration during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她試著在會議中隱藏自己的挫折感。

examples.en: Please write your name, age, and gender on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫姓名、年齡和性別。

examples.en: The school treats students equally, regardless of gender.
examples.zh: 學校不分性別，平等對待學生。

examples.en: Gender should not limit the jobs that children dream about.
examples.zh: 性別不應該限制孩子夢想的職業。

examples.en: She found a grammatical mistake in my essay.
examples.zh: 她在我的作文裡發現一個文法錯誤。

examples.en: This sentence sounds natural, but it is not grammatical.
examples.zh: 這個句子聽起來自然，但不符合文法。

examples.en: The teacher explained the grammatical rules of the past tense.
examples.zh: 老師講解了過去式的文法規則。

examples.en: The graph shows how the temperature changed during the week.
examples.zh: 這張圖表顯示一週內氣溫如何變化。

examples.en: Students drew a bar graph of their favorite fruits.
examples.zh: 學生們把最喜歡的水果畫成長條統計圖。

examples.en: Look at the line graph on page ten.
examples.zh: 請看第十頁的折線圖。

examples.en: In her haste, she left her umbrella on the bus.
examples.zh: 她匆忙之中把雨傘忘在公車上。

examples.en: Haste makes waste, so check your answers carefully.
examples.zh: 欲速則不達，所以要仔細檢查答案。

examples.en: He packed his bag with haste and ran to the station.
examples.zh: 他匆忙收好背包，跑向車站。

examples.en: The heavy rain hastened our decision to go home.
examples.zh: 大雨促使我們更快決定回家。

examples.en: She hastened to the classroom when the bell rang.
examples.zh: 鈴聲一響，她趕緊跑向教室。

examples.en: Too much sugar can hasten the decay of your teeth.
examples.zh: 過多糖分可能加速牙齒蛀蝕。

examples.en: Her grandparents immigrated to Canada in 1980.
examples.zh: 她的祖父母在 1980 年移民到加拿大。

examples.en: Many families immigrate to Australia to give their children a better education.
examples.zh: 許多家庭移民澳洲，好讓孩子接受更好的教育。

examples.en: He plans to immigrate after he finishes his studies.
examples.zh: 他打算完成學業後移居國外。

examples.en: The restaurant passed the health inspection last week.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳上週通過了衛生檢查。

examples.en: The mechanic carried out a safety inspection before returning the car.
examples.zh: 技師把車交還之前，先進行了安全檢查。

examples.en: The principal made an inspection of the new classrooms.
examples.zh: 校長視察了新教室。

examples.en: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 暴風雨的強度讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: Doctors recommend exercise of moderate intensity for beginners.
examples.zh: 醫師建議初學者進行中等強度的運動。

examples.en: The intensity of the light made her close her eyes.
examples.zh: 光線太強，她閉上了眼睛。

examples.en: Online classes limit face-to-face interaction between classmates.
examples.zh: 線上課程限制了同學之間面對面的互動。

examples.en: Babies learn to speak through interaction with their parents.
examples.zh: 嬰兒透過與父母互動學會說話。

examples.en: The interaction between the two chemicals produced a gas.
examples.zh: 這兩種化學物質之間的交互作用產生了氣體。

examples.en: Sorry for the interruption, but you have a phone call.
examples.zh: 抱歉打擾了，你有一通電話。

examples.en: The storm caused an interruption in the power supply.
examples.zh: 暴風雨造成電力供應中斷。

examples.en: She studied in the library for two hours without any interruption.
examples.zh: 她在圖書館不受打擾地讀了兩個小時的書。

examples.en: My intuition told me that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 我的直覺告訴我有什麼地方不對勁。

examples.en: She chose the answer by intuition, not by careful thought.
examples.zh: 她憑直覺選了答案，而不是仔細思考。

examples.en: A good doctor uses both knowledge and intuition.
examples.zh: 好醫生同時運用知識與直覺。

examples.en: The police opened an investigation into the missing wallet.
examples.zh: 警方針對遺失的皮夾展開調查。

examples.en: An investigation into the cause of the fire is still under way.
examples.zh: 火災原因的調查仍在進行中。

examples.en: Scientists carried out a long investigation of the river's pollution.
examples.zh: 科學家對這條河的汙染進行了長期研究。

examples.en: The lifeguard blew a whistle when the children swam too far.
examples.zh: 孩子們游得太遠時，救生員吹了哨子。

examples.en: She works as a lifeguard at the community pool in summer.
examples.zh: 她夏天在社區游泳池擔任救生員。

examples.en: A lifeguard sat on a tall chair and watched the beach.
examples.zh: 一位救生員坐在高椅上看守海灘。

examples.en: The millionaire donated money to build a new library.
examples.zh: 那位百萬富翁捐錢蓋了一座新圖書館。

examples.en: He became a millionaire after selling his software company.
examples.zh: 他賣掉軟體公司後成了百萬富翁。

examples.en: Few people become millionaires without years of hard work.
examples.zh: 很少有人能在未經多年努力的情況下成為百萬富翁。

examples.en: A mule carried the heavy bags up the mountain path.
examples.zh: 一頭騾子把沉重的袋子馱上山路。

examples.en: The mule is a cross between a horse and a donkey.
examples.zh: 騾子是馬和驢雜交所生的動物。

examples.en: My brother is as stubborn as a mule when he wants something.
examples.zh: 我哥哥想要某樣東西時，固執得像頭騾子。

examples.en: Fresh vegetables provide a nutritious addition to our school lunches.
examples.zh: 新鮮蔬菜為我們的學校午餐增添營養。

examples.en: My mother makes a nutritious breakfast every morning.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每天早上都準備營養豐富的早餐。

examples.en: School lunches should be tasty as well as nutritious.
examples.zh: 學校午餐不只要好吃，也要有營養。

examples.en: Dogs are trained to show obedience to their owners.
examples.zh: 狗被訓練成要服從主人。

examples.en: The teacher expects obedience to the classroom rules.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生遵守課堂規範。

examples.en: Obedience is important, but children also need to think for themselves.
examples.zh: 服從很重要，但孩子也需要自己思考。

senses.zh: 新生訓練；職前訓練；方位

examples.en: All new students must attend orientation on the first day.
examples.zh: 所有新生都必須參加第一天的新生訓練。

examples.en: The company holds an orientation for new employees every month.
examples.zh: 公司每個月為新員工舉辦一次職前訓練。

examples.en: Without a compass, we lost our sense of orientation in the forest.
examples.zh: 沒有指南針，我們在森林裡失去了方位感。

examples.en: Class participation counts for ten percent of your grade.
examples.zh: 課堂參與占成績的百分之十。

examples.en: Thank you for your participation in our school fair.
examples.zh: 感謝你參加我們的學校園遊會。

examples.en: The coach praised the team's active participation in practice.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚球隊在練習中的積極參與。

examples.en: Please take the pickle out of my hamburger.
examples.zh: 請把我漢堡裡的醃黃瓜拿掉。

examples.en: Grandma keeps a jar of homemade pickles in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 奶奶在廚房放了一罐自製的醃菜。

examples.en: A sour pickle goes well with a fried chicken sandwich.
examples.zh: 酸酸的醃黃瓜很適合搭炸雞三明治。

examples.en: My aunt likes to pickle cabbage in the fall.
examples.zh: 我阿姨喜歡在秋天醃高麗菜。

examples.en: They pickled the radishes in vinegar and salt.
examples.zh: 他們用醋和鹽醃漬白蘿蔔。

examples.en: It takes a few days to pickle cucumbers properly.
examples.zh: 要把小黃瓜醃漬好需要幾天時間。

examples.en: The singer's popularity grew quickly after she released her first song.
examples.zh: 那位歌手推出第一首歌後，人氣迅速上升。

examples.en: This game has gained popularity among teenagers.
examples.zh: 這款遊戲在青少年之間越來越受歡迎。

examples.en: The popularity of bubble tea has spread around the world.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶的人氣已傳遍全世界。

examples.en: The museum is responsible for the preservation of old paintings.
examples.zh: 博物館負責保存古老的畫作。

examples.en: Many groups work for the preservation of forests.
examples.zh: 許多團體致力於保護森林。

examples.en: Proper preservation keeps food fresh for a longer time.
examples.zh: 適當的保存方式能讓食物保鮮更久。

examples.en: Safety is our first priority on every trip.
examples.zh: 每趟旅程中，安全都是我們的首要之務。

examples.en: You should make homework a priority before playing games.
examples.zh: 玩遊戲之前，你應該把功課列為優先事項。

examples.en: Passengers with young children get priority when boarding.
examples.zh: 帶幼童的乘客可享有優先登機權。

examples.en: The essay begins with a quotation from a famous poem.
examples.zh: 這篇文章以一段知名詩作的引文開頭。

examples.en: Please send me a quotation for fifty chairs.
examples.zh: 請寄給我五十張椅子的報價。

examples.en: She wrote a short quotation on the card for her teacher.
examples.zh: 她在給老師的卡片上寫了一段簡短的引文。

examples.en: You can get a full refund if you return the shirt within a week.
examples.zh: 一週內退回襯衫就能全額退款。

examples.en: The airline offered me a refund after the flight was canceled.
examples.zh: 航班取消後，航空公司提供我退款。

examples.en: I am still waiting for my refund from the online store.
examples.zh: 我還在等網路商店的退款。

examples.en: The shop will refund your money if the product is broken.
examples.zh: 如果商品壞了，商店會退錢給你。

examples.en: Please refund the ticket price to my credit card.
examples.zh: 請把票款退回我的信用卡。

examples.en: They refunded all the students who missed the trip.
examples.zh: 他們把費用退還給所有沒去旅行的學生。

examples.en: She felt sad about the rejection of her application.
examples.zh: 她對申請被拒絕感到難過。

examples.en: His rejection of the offer surprised the whole team.
examples.zh: 他拒絕這項提議，讓全隊都很驚訝。

examples.en: The editor sent a polite rejection letter to the writer.
examples.zh: 編輯寄了一封禮貌的退稿信給作者。

examples.en: Please bring all the relevant documents to the interview.
examples.zh: 請把所有相關文件帶來面試。

examples.en: Your comment is not relevant to this topic.
examples.zh: 你的意見和這個主題無關。

examples.en: Teachers choose reading materials that are relevant to students' lives.
examples.zh: 老師選擇與學生生活相關的閱讀材料。

senses.zh: 體面的；值得尊敬的；相當不錯的

examples.en: He has a respectable job at a local bank.
examples.zh: 他在當地銀行有一份體面的工作。

examples.en: She earned a respectable score on the English test.
examples.zh: 她在英文考試中拿到了相當不錯的分數。

examples.en: She comes from a respectable family that supports local charities.
examples.zh: 她出身於一個支持當地慈善團體、值得尊敬的家庭。

senses.zh: 恭敬的；有禮貌的；表示尊重的

examples.en: Students should be respectful to their teachers.
examples.zh: 學生應該對老師有禮貌。

examples.en: He gave a respectful bow before entering the room.
examples.zh: 他進房間前恭敬地鞠了個躬。

examples.en: Please be respectful when others are speaking.
examples.zh: 別人發言時請表示尊重。

examples.en: Our family has a reunion every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我們家每年農曆新年都會團圓。

examples.en: She cried happily at the reunion with her old friends.
examples.zh: 她和老朋友重逢時開心地哭了。

examples.en: The class reunion will be held at a restaurant next month.
examples.zh: 同學會下個月會在一間餐廳舉行。

examples.en: I could hear the sincerity in her voice.
examples.zh: 我聽得出她聲音裡的真誠。

examples.en: He thanked the teacher with great sincerity.
examples.zh: 他非常誠懇地感謝老師。

examples.en: Nobody doubted the sincerity of his apology.
examples.zh: 沒有人懷疑他道歉的誠意。

examples.en: This statistic shows how many students ride bikes to school.
examples.zh: 這個統計數字顯示有多少學生騎腳踏車上學。

examples.en: The report includes a surprising statistic about sleep.
examples.zh: 這份報告包含一個關於睡眠的驚人統計數字。

examples.en: One statistic says that most customers shop online.
examples.zh: 有一項統計指出，大部分顧客都在網路上購物。

examples.en: The zebra has black and white stripes.
examples.zh: 斑馬身上有黑白相間的條紋。

examples.en: She bought a shirt with blue stripes.
examples.zh: 她買了一件藍色條紋的襯衫。

examples.en: The white stripes on the road mark the pedestrian crossing.
examples.zh: 馬路上的白色條紋標示出斑馬線的位置。

examples.en: The customer decided to sue the company for the broken phone.
examples.zh: 那位顧客決定因為壞掉的手機而控告那家公司。

examples.en: They threatened to sue the landlord over the unpaid deposit.
examples.zh: 他們威脅要為了未退還的押金控告房東。

examples.en: You can sue if the store refuses to give you a refund.
examples.zh: 如果商店拒絕退款，你可以提起訴訟。

examples.en: The trees sway gently in the evening breeze.
examples.zh: 樹木在傍晚的微風中輕輕搖擺。

examples.en: The passengers swayed as the bus turned the corner.
examples.zh: 公車轉彎時，乘客跟著搖晃。

examples.en: Her speech helped sway the voters in the class election.
examples.zh: 她的演說有助於影響班上選舉的選民。

examples.en: The sway of the boat made me feel sick.
examples.zh: 船的搖擺讓我覺得想吐。

examples.en: The old tradition still holds sway over life in the village.
examples.zh: 這項古老的傳統仍支配著村裡的生活。

examples.en: We watched the slow sway of the tall grass.
examples.zh: 我們看著高高的草緩緩搖擺。

examples.en: Waiting for the test results was pure torture.
examples.zh: 等待考試成績簡直是一種煎熬。

examples.en: Sitting through a three-hour meeting felt like torture.
examples.zh: 坐著開完三小時的會議像是一種折磨。

examples.en: The history lesson explained why torture is prohibited under international law.
examples.zh: 這堂歷史課說明了為什麼國際法禁止酷刑。

examples.en: The museum has a collection of tribal masks.
examples.zh: 博物館有一批部落面具的收藏。

examples.en: Tribal leaders met to discuss the future of their land.
examples.zh: 部落領袖聚在一起討論他們土地的未來。

examples.en: We listened to tribal music at the cultural festival.
examples.zh: 我們在文化節聽了部落音樂。

examples.en: The company has a vacancy for a new designer.
examples.zh: 這家公司有一個新設計師的職缺。

examples.en: The hotel sign said there was no vacancy tonight.
examples.zh: 飯店的告示牌寫著今晚沒有空房。

examples.en: We have a vacancy in our club, so please join us.
examples.zh: 我們社團有個空缺，歡迎你加入。

examples.en: A friendly workplace makes everyone feel comfortable.
examples.zh: 友善的工作環境讓每個人都覺得自在。

examples.en: Safety rules are posted all over the workplace.
examples.zh: 工作場所到處都張貼著安全規定。

examples.en: She learned many useful skills in her first workplace.
examples.zh: 她在第一個職場學到許多實用的技能。

examples.en: The calculation took me only a few minutes.
examples.zh: 這個計算只花了我幾分鐘。

examples.en: My calculation shows that the trip will cost about NT$5,000.
examples.zh: 我的估算顯示這趟旅行大約要花新台幣五千元。

examples.en: Please check your calculation again before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 交出去之前，請再檢查一次你的計算。

examples.en: I found a nice lamp in the furniture catalogue.
examples.zh: 我在家具型錄裡找到一盞很棒的檯燈。

examples.en: The library catalogue lists every book on the shelves.
examples.zh: 圖書館目錄列出書架上的每一本書。

examples.en: The store will send you a free catalogue by mail.
examples.zh: 這家店會用郵寄方式寄給你一本免費型錄。

examples.en: The librarian will catalogue all the new books this week.
examples.zh: 圖書館員這週會把所有新書編入目錄。

examples.en: Volunteers helped catalogue the museum's old photographs.
examples.zh: 志工協助將博物館的老照片編入目錄。

examples.en: She spent the weekend cataloguing her stamp collection.
examples.zh: 她花了一個週末把她的郵票收藏編成目錄。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my earphones to the gym.
examples.zh: 我忘了把耳機帶去健身房。

examples.en: One earphone stopped working after a week.
examples.zh: 有一邊耳機用了一個星期就壞了。

examples.en: Please use an earphone when you watch videos on the train.
examples.zh: 在火車上看影片時，請使用耳機。

examples.en: The museum teaches students about the invasion of ancient cities.
examples.zh: 博物館教導學生古代城市遭入侵的歷史。

examples.en: Reading my diary is an invasion of my privacy.
examples.zh: 偷看我的日記是侵犯我的隱私。

examples.en: Farmers worried about an invasion of insects this summer.
examples.zh: 農民擔心今年夏天會有昆蟲大量入侵。

examples.en: Long ago, people sent news by telegraph.
examples.zh: 很久以前，人們用電報傳遞消息。

examples.en: The museum has an old telegraph from the 1800s.
examples.zh: 博物館有一台十九世紀的舊電報機。

examples.en: The telegraph let people send messages across the country quickly.
examples.zh: 電報讓人們能迅速把訊息傳到全國各地。

examples.en: We visited an old abbey during our trip to England.
examples.zh: 我們到英國旅行時參觀了一座古老的修道院。

examples.en: The abbey is famous for its beautiful stone walls.
examples.zh: 這座修道院以美麗的石牆聞名。

examples.en: Monks have lived in this abbey for hundreds of years.
examples.zh: 修士們在這座修道院裡住了幾百年。

examples.en: "Dr." is a common abbreviation for the word "doctor".
examples.zh: 「Dr.」是「doctor」這個字的常見縮寫。

examples.en: What is the abbreviation for Taipei Main Station?
examples.zh: 台北車站的縮寫是什麼？

examples.en: Please write the full word instead of using an abbreviation.
examples.zh: 請寫出完整的字，不要使用縮寫。

examples.en: The doctor pressed gently on my abdomen.
examples.zh: 醫生輕輕按壓我的腹部。

examples.en: She felt a sharp pain in her lower abdomen.
examples.zh: 她覺得下腹部一陣劇痛。

examples.en: An insect's body consists of a head, a thorax, and an abdomen.
examples.zh: 昆蟲的身體由頭部、胸部和腹部組成。

examples.en: The old textbook uses the term aborigine for Australia's original inhabitants.
examples.zh: 這本舊課本用 aborigine 一詞稱呼澳洲的原住民。

examples.en: The nineteenth-century diary describes an aborigine guiding explorers through the forest.
examples.zh: 這本十九世紀的日記描述一位原住民帶領探險家穿越森林。

examples.en: The old book records stories that an aborigine shared with travelers.
examples.zh: 這本舊書記錄了一位原住民與旅人分享的故事。

examples.en: My absent-minded uncle often forgets where he put his keys.
examples.zh: 我那心不在焉的叔叔常常忘記把鑰匙放哪裡。

examples.en: She was so absent-minded that she wore two different shoes.
examples.zh: 她太心不在焉，結果穿了兩隻不一樣的鞋子。

examples.en: The absent-minded student left his lunch box on the bus.
examples.zh: 那個心不在焉的學生把便當盒忘在公車上。

examples.en: The car's quick acceleration surprised the driver.
examples.zh: 這輛車加速很快，讓駕駛嚇了一跳。

examples.en: Our science class measured the acceleration of a rolling ball.
examples.zh: 我們的自然課測量了滾動的球的加速度。

examples.en: The acceleration of the train was smooth and quiet.
examples.zh: 火車的加速平穩又安靜。

examples.en: She is an accomplished pianist who plays around the world.
examples.zh: 她是一位技藝高超的鋼琴家，在世界各地演奏。

examples.en: My aunt is an accomplished cook who teaches at a culinary school.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是一位廚藝高超的廚師，在烹飪學校教書。

examples.en: He became an accomplished writer before the age of thirty.
examples.zh: 他在三十歲前就成為一位有成就的作家。

examples.en: I am not accustomed to waking up so early.
examples.zh: 我不習慣這麼早起床。

examples.en: She soon became accustomed to the busy city life.
examples.zh: 她很快就習慣了繁忙的都市生活。

examples.en: Many students are accustomed to studying with music on.
examples.zh: 許多學生習慣邊聽音樂邊讀書。

senses.zh: 王牌；高手；撲克牌的 A

examples.en: He is the ace of our school baseball team.
examples.zh: 他是我們學校棒球隊的王牌。

examples.en: Lily drew the ace of hearts in the card game.
examples.zh: 莉莉在紙牌遊戲中抽到了紅心 A。

examples.en: My sister is an ace at solving math problems.
examples.zh: 我姊姊是解數學題目的高手。

examples.en: She is an ace pilot with years of experience.
examples.zh: 她是一位有多年經驗的一流飛行員。

examples.en: The ace reporter wrote the best story of the year.
examples.zh: 這位頂尖記者寫出了年度最佳報導。

examples.en: They hired an ace designer for the new shop.
examples.zh: 他們為新店請了一位一流的設計師。

senses.zh: 聲音的；原聲的；非電子的

examples.en: He plays an acoustic guitar in the school band.
examples.zh: 他在學校樂團彈木吉他。

examples.en: The hall has excellent acoustic quality for concerts.
examples.zh: 這間禮堂的音響效果很適合辦音樂會。

examples.en: The singer gave an acoustic performance without any speakers.
examples.zh: 那位歌手不用任何喇叭，進行了一場原聲演出。

examples.en: She dreams of a career in acting.
examples.zh: 她夢想從事演戲的工作。

examples.en: His acting in the school play was wonderful.
examples.zh: 他在學校話劇中的演出很精彩。

examples.en: Acting classes helped him feel less nervous on stage.
examples.zh: 表演課幫助他在台上不再那麼緊張。

examples.en: The acting principal welcomed us to the new school year.
examples.zh: 代理校長歡迎我們來到新學年。

examples.en: Mr. Chen is the acting manager while Ms. Lin is away.
examples.zh: 林小姐不在時，陳先生擔任代理經理。

examples.en: The acting director will sign the document on Monday.
examples.zh: 代理主任星期一會在文件上簽名。

examples.en: Press this button to activate the alarm.
examples.zh: 按下這個按鈕來啟動警報器。

examples.en: You need to activate your new phone card first.
examples.zh: 你必須先啟用你的新電話卡。

examples.en: The motion sensor will activate the lights when you walk in.
examples.zh: 你走進來時，動作感應器會啟動燈光。

examples.en: Many teenagers are addicted to their phones.
examples.zh: 許多青少年對手機上癮。

examples.en: My brother is addicted to this video game.
examples.zh: 我弟弟沉迷於這款電玩。

examples.en: She got addicted to sweet drinks during the summer.
examples.zh: 她在夏天對含糖飲料上了癮。

examples.en: This juice contains no artificial additives, according to the label.
examples.zh: 根據標示，這種果汁不含人工添加物。

examples.en: Check the label for any additive you are allergic to.
examples.zh: 請看標籤上有沒有你會過敏的添加物。

examples.en: A food additive can help bread stay fresh longer.
examples.zh: 食品添加物可以讓麵包保存得更久。

examples.en: The sticker will adhere to any clean, flat surface.
examples.zh: 這張貼紙可以黏附在任何乾淨的平面上。

examples.en: All students must adhere to the school rules.
examples.zh: 所有學生都必須遵守校規。

examples.en: She adheres to a strict study plan every week.
examples.zh: 她每週都遵循嚴格的讀書計畫。

examples.en: Our classroom is adjacent to the library.
examples.zh: 我們的教室緊鄰圖書館。

examples.en: The hotel has two adjacent rooms for families.
examples.zh: 這間飯店有兩間相鄰的房間供家庭使用。

examples.en: A small park is adjacent to the school gate.
examples.zh: 一座小公園就在校門旁邊。

examples.en: The kitchen adjoins the dining room, making it easy to serve meals.
examples.zh: 廚房緊鄰餐廳，方便上菜。

examples.en: Our garden adjoins a quiet park where local children often play.
examples.zh: 我們家的花園緊鄰一座安靜的公園，當地小孩常在那裡玩耍。

examples.en: The two rooms adjoin, with a connecting door between them.
examples.zh: 這兩間房間相鄰，中間設有一道連通門。

examples.en: The mechanic made a small adjustment to the bike seat.
examples.zh: 技師對腳踏車座椅做了一個小調整。

examples.en: Moving to a new school requires some adjustment.
examples.zh: 轉到新學校需要一些適應。

examples.en: We made an adjustment to the schedule because of the typhoon.
examples.zh: 因為颱風，我們調整了時程表。

examples.en: Adulthood brings new freedom and new responsibilities.
examples.zh: 成年期帶來新的自由與新的責任。

examples.en: Many people move out of their parents' home in early adulthood.
examples.zh: 許多人在成年初期就搬出父母的家。

examples.en: He reached adulthood and began to plan his own future.
examples.zh: 他成年了，開始規劃自己的未來。

examples.en: Advancement in technology has changed the way we live.
examples.zh: 科技的進步改變了我們的生活方式。

examples.en: She worked hard for her advancement at the company.
examples.zh: 她為了在公司的晉升而努力工作。

examples.en: The school supports the advancement of every student.
examples.zh: 學校支持每位學生的進步。

examples.en: The advent of smartphones changed how we take photos.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了我們拍照的方式。

examples.en: The advent of spring brings warmer weather.
examples.zh: 春天的來臨帶來較溫暖的天氣。

examples.en: Online shopping grew quickly after the advent of the internet.
examples.zh: 網路出現後，網路購物迅速成長。

examples.en: In "She ran quickly," the word "quickly" is an adverb.
examples.zh: 在「She ran quickly」這個句子中，quickly 是副詞。

examples.en: Our English teacher asked us to underline each adverb.
examples.zh: 英文老師要我們把每個副詞畫上底線。

examples.en: An adverb can describe a verb, an adjective, or another adverb.
examples.zh: 副詞可以修飾動詞、形容詞或另一個副詞。

examples.en: I saw an advert for a new bakery on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公車上看到一則新麵包店的廣告。

examples.en: The advert on TV made me hungry.
examples.zh: 電視上的廣告讓我肚子餓了。

examples.en: She answered an advert for a part-time job.
examples.zh: 她應徵了廣告上的兼職工作。

examples.en: The advertiser paid for a full page in the magazine.
examples.zh: 廣告商付錢買下雜誌的整頁版面。

examples.en: Every advertiser wants to reach more young customers.
examples.zh: 每位廣告商都想接觸更多年輕顧客。

examples.en: The website earns money from advertisers who pay for banner space.
examples.zh: 這個網站從付費購買橫幅廣告版位的廣告主取得收入。

examples.en: Advertising helps companies sell their products and attract new customers.
examples.zh: 廣告幫助公司銷售產品，並吸引新顧客。

examples.en: She works in advertising and designs posters for stores.
examples.zh: 她在廣告業工作，為商店設計海報。

examples.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising every year.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年花很多錢在廣告上。

examples.en: It is advisable to bring an umbrella in the rainy season.
examples.zh: 雨季帶把傘是明智的。

examples.en: Doctors say it is advisable to drink more water.
examples.zh: 醫生說多喝水是可取的。

examples.en: Is it advisable to travel during the holiday?
examples.zh: 假期期間出遊明智嗎？

examples.en: The aerial photo shows the whole city.
examples.zh: 這張空拍照片呈現了整座城市。

examples.en: We enjoyed an aerial view of the mountains from the plane.
examples.zh: 我們從飛機上欣賞山脈的空中景色。

examples.en: The team used an aerial camera to film the festival.
examples.zh: 團隊用空拍攝影機拍攝這場慶典。

examples.en: Dad fixed the aerial on the roof so the TV works again.
examples.zh: 爸爸修好屋頂上的天線，電視又能看了。

examples.en: The old radio has a long metal aerial.
examples.zh: 那台舊收音機有一根長長的金屬天線。

examples.en: Strong wind bent the aerial on our car.
examples.zh: 強風把我們車上的天線吹彎了。

examples.en: My uncle works in the aerospace industry.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在航太產業工作。

examples.en: She wants to study aerospace engineering at university.
examples.zh: 她想在大學主修航太工程。

examples.en: Aerospace companies build planes and spacecraft for commercial and scientific use.
examples.zh: 航太公司製造商業與科學用途的飛機和太空船。

examples.en: The designer cares a lot about the aesthetics of the room.
examples.zh: 設計師非常重視房間的美感。

examples.en: Aesthetics is a popular class in the art department.
examples.zh: 美學是藝術系一門熱門的課。

examples.en: Simple lines are important in modern aesthetics.
examples.zh: 簡潔的線條在現代美學中很重要。

examples.en: Back pain afflicts many office workers who sit for long periods.
examples.zh: 背痛困擾著許多久坐的上班族。

examples.en: The village has been afflicted by hot, dry weather.
examples.zh: 這座村莊飽受炎熱乾燥的天氣之苦。

examples.en: Allergies afflict millions of people every spring.
examples.zh: 過敏在每年春天困擾著數百萬人。

examples.en: In the aftermath of the typhoon, neighbors helped clean the streets.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，鄰居們幫忙清理街道。

examples.en: The school reviewed its safety rules in the aftermath of the fire.
examples.zh: 火災過後，學校檢討了安全規範。

examples.en: The company is still dealing with the aftermath of the mistake.
examples.zh: 公司仍在處理那個錯誤所帶來的後果。

examples.en: Scratching the rash will only aggravate it.
examples.zh: 抓皮膚疹只會讓它更嚴重。

examples.en: Loud noise can aggravate a headache, so she rested in silence.
examples.zh: 吵雜的聲音可能讓頭痛加劇，所以她安靜地休息。

examples.en: His constant complaints began to aggravate his roommates.
examples.zh: 他不斷的抱怨開始惹惱他的室友。

examples.en: The aggregate of the two scores decided the winner.
examples.zh: 兩次成績的總分決定了贏家。

examples.en: In the aggregate, sales rose by ten percent.
examples.zh: 整體來看，銷售量上升了百分之十。

examples.en: The total is an aggregate of donations from many families.
examples.zh: 這筆總額是許多家庭捐款的合計。

examples.en: The aggregate score of both games was 5 to 3.
examples.zh: 兩場比賽的總比數是五比三。

examples.en: The aggregate cost of the trip was higher than we planned.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行的總花費比我們計畫的高。

examples.en: Aggregate sales for the year reached a new record.
examples.zh: 本年度的總銷售額創下新紀錄。

examples.en: Regular exercise can slow down aging and help people stay active.
examples.zh: 規律運動可以減緩老化，幫助人們維持活力。

examples.en: Aging is a natural part of life.
examples.zh: 老化是生命中很自然的一部分。

examples.en: This cream is made to reduce the signs of aging.
examples.zh: 這款乳霜是為了減少老化的跡象而製作的。

examples.en: Taiwan has an aging population, which increases the demand for elder care.
examples.zh: 台灣面臨人口老化，對長者照護的需求因而增加。

examples.en: My aging grandfather still walks in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我年邁的爺爺每天早上仍在公園散步。

examples.en: The aging bridge needs to be repaired soon.
examples.zh: 這座老舊的橋很快就需要修復。

examples.en: The loud noise began to agitate the baby.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的聲音開始讓寶寶不安。

examples.en: The washing machine agitates the clothes to remove dirt.
examples.zh: 洗衣機攪動衣物，以去除汙垢。

examples.en: Some students agitate for a longer lunch break.
examples.zh: 有些學生積極倡議延長午休時間。
